#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Replay lsg1 (#215, SG-1 (CounterLoop); branch lean/dedup-sg1, stacked on the campaign after #209): its downstream closure (102 modules),
# fresh .oleans into oleans-lsg1, a copy of oleans-lnth, via scripts/lean_check_tree.sh. The root TCSlib
# module is not listed (replay rule). The precheck pins the changed files' blobs.
S=/home/user/tcslib-scratch
WT="$S/wt-sg1"
LIST="/home/user/tcslib-scratch/fills/replay/down-lsg1.txt"
LOG="$S/fills/replay/replay-lsg1.log"
PINS="TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/CounterLoop.lean:f5c2314ef0b7512c37f96a85140f5327b23c4f73"
[ -d "$WT/.lake/packages/mathlib/.lake/build/lib/lean/Mathlib" ] || { echo "precheck: $WT/.lake/packages has no Mathlib build; nothing copied" >&2; exit 2; }
git -C "$WT" fetch -q origin 2>/dev/null
[ "$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse origin/lean/dedup-sg1 2>/dev/null)" ] || { echo "precheck: $WT is not at the pushed PR head; nothing copied" >&2; exit 2; }
[ -z "$(git -C "$WT" status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)" ] || { echo "precheck: $WT has local changes; nothing copied" >&2; exit 2; }
git -C "$WT" merge-base --is-ancestor 7f4ab280559c774c9a3703e7cf157858b3fd2d8b HEAD || { echo "precheck: the head must contain the campaign after #209; nothing copied" >&2; exit 2; }
[ "$(git -C "$WT" diff --name-only 7f4ab280559c774c9a3703e7cf157858b3fd2d8b HEAD -- '*.lean' | sort)" = "$(printf '%s\n' "$PINS" | cut -d: -f1 | sort)" ] || { echo "precheck: the Lean diff from the campaign after #209 must be exactly the pinned files; nothing copied" >&2; exit 2; }
while IFS=: read -r f b; do
  [ "$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse "HEAD:$f")" = "$b" ] || { echo "precheck: $f is not the checked blob; nothing copied" >&2; exit 2; }
done <<< "$PINS"
tail -1 "/home/user/tcslib-scratch/fills/replay/replay-lnth.log" 2>/dev/null | grep -qx "# modules=[0-9]* failed=0" || { echo "precheck: the previous replay must have passed; nothing copied" >&2; exit 2; }
[ "$(wc -l < "$LIST" | tr -d ' ')" = "102" ] || { echo "precheck: the replay list must have 102 modules; nothing copied" >&2; exit 2; }
grep -qx "TCSlib" "$LIST" && { echo "precheck: the replay list must not contain the root TCSlib; nothing copied" >&2; exit 2; }
[ -d "$S/oleans-lsg1" ] && { echo "precheck: $S/oleans-lsg1 already exists; remove it for a fresh copy" >&2; exit 2; }
[ -d "$S/oleans-lnth" ] || { echo "precheck: oleans-lnth is missing; nothing copied" >&2; exit 2; }
cp -R "$S/oleans-lnth" "$S/oleans-lsg1" || exit 1
cd "$WT" || exit 1
{ echo "# replay-lsg1 at $(git rev-parse --short HEAD): #215, SG-1 (CounterLoop) ($(wc -l < "$LIST" | tr -d ' ') modules), fresh .oleans into oleans-lsg1"
  n=0; f=0
  while read -r m; do
    n=$((n+1))
    out=$(TCSLIB_OLEANS=$S/oleans-lsg1 nice -n 10 bash scripts/lean_check_tree.sh "$m" 2>&1); st=$?
    e=$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -c "error")
    echo "$m exit=$st errors=$e sorry=$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -c "declaration uses 'sorry'")"
    [ $st -ne 0 ] && { f=$((f+1)); printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep error | head -3 | sed "s#$PWD/##g"; }
  done < "$LIST"
  echo "# modules=$n failed=$f"
} > "$LOG" 2>&1
python3 -I "$S/api/staticsorry.py" "$WT" "$LOG" > "${LOG%.log}-static.txt"; sst=$?
tail -n 6 "$LOG"
tail -n 1 "${LOG%.log}-static.txt"
# the exit status: nonzero unless every listed module passed and the static check found no mismatch
tail -1 "$LOG" | grep -qx "# modules=102 failed=0" || { echo "replay: a module failed, or the count is not 102" >&2; exit 1; }
[ $sst -eq 0 ] && tail -1 "${LOG%.log}-static.txt" | grep -q "mismatches 0," || { echo "replay: the static sorry check failed" >&2; exit 1; }
exit 0

```
"""Copy only completed, statically checked replays into their gate records."""

from pathlib import Path
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys


records = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
scratch = Path(os.environ["TCSLIB_SCRATCH"])
cases = {"106-sg1-dedup": ("msg1", "wt-sg1", 329, 0),
         "114-natbits-dedup": ("mnb1", "wt-natbits", 344, 0),
         "115-epad-fill": ("mepad1", "wt-epad", 2, -1)}
pattern = re.compile(r"^(\S+) exit=(\d+) errors=(\d+) sorry=(\d+)$", re.M)
base_log = (scratch / "fills/replay/bootstrap-oleans-mac0.log").read_text()
assert base_log.splitlines()[-1] == "# modules=894 failed=0"
base_counts = {m: int(k) for m, _, _, k in pattern.findall(base_log)}
for gate in sys.argv[1:] or cases:
    name, wt, count, expected_delta = cases[gate]
    evidence = records / "campaign/gates" / gate / "evidence/current"
    inputs = json.loads((evidence / "landing/refs.json").read_text())
    commits = {}
    for label, tree in (("head", wt), ("base", "wt-camp")):
        sha = subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(scratch / tree), "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip()
        subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(records), "cat-file", "-e", sha + "^{commit}"], check=True)
        assert sha == inputs[label], (gate, label, sha, inputs[label])
        commits[label] = sha
    replay = scratch / "fills/replay"
    log = (replay / ("replay-" + name + ".log")).read_text()
    assert log.splitlines()[-1] == f"# modules={count} failed=0"
    rows = pattern.findall(log)
    assert len(rows) == count and all(int(st) == int(errors) == 0 for _, st, errors, _ in rows)
    static = (replay / ("replay-" + name + "-static.txt")).read_text()
    assert re.search(rf"modules {count}, mismatches 0, static total \d+\n?$", static)
    assert all(m in base_counts or m.endswith("/NatBits") for m, *_ in rows)
    prior = sum(base_counts.get(m, 0) for m, *_ in rows)
    current = sum(int(k) for _, _, _, k in rows)
    assert current - prior == expected_delta, (gate, prior, current)
    changes = [{"module": m, "base": base_counts.get(m, 0), "head": int(k)}
               for m, _, _, k in rows if base_counts.get(m, 0) != int(k)]
    dest = evidence / "merged-tree"
    dest.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    for filename in ("down-" + name + ".txt", "replay-" + name + ".sh",
                     "precheck-" + name + ".sh", "replay-" + name + ".log",
                     "replay-" + name + "-static.txt"):
        shutil.copy2(replay / filename, dest / filename)
    receipt = {**commits, "snapshot": "oleans-" + name, "previous_snapshot": "oleans-mac0",
               "modules": count, "failed": 0, "static_mismatches": 0,
               "base_sorry_declarations_in_closure": prior,
               "head_sorry_declarations_in_closure": current,
               "sorry_declaration_delta": current - prior, "sorry_changes": changes}
    (dest / "receipt.json").write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(gate, count, "passed; sorry declarations", prior, "to", current)
```

## ===== campaign/status/2026-11-06-mac-bootstrap/exchange-README-next.md =====

# Exchange: Arora–Barak ch. 3–4

The hand-off folders between the ch. 3–4 maintainer session and the user, who dispatches briefs
and audit packs to external agents and brings back what they deliver. This subfolder of the
orphan branch `exchange/pass-shelat-ch5-8` belongs to the ch. 3–4 campaign. The records (plans,
packs, findings, resolutions, evidence) live on `complexity/arora-barak-ch3-4` under `campaign/`.
This folder only carries files in transit. The maintainer's rules are in that branch's
`campaign/maintainer/WORKFLOW.md`.

| Folder | Holds | Who writes |
|---|---|---|
| `outbox/gates/<NN>-<slug>-gate/` | a gate ready to dispatch: the bundle to attach, `BUNDLE-FILES.txt`, `SHA256SUMS`, `README.md` | maintainer |
| `outbox/fills/` | a fill dispatch: the issued brief and the environment addendum to attach | maintainer |
| `inbox/` | what comes back: delivery zips (`fill-<item>.zip`, checkpoint zips, `REPORT-*.md`) and findings files (`<name>-findings.md`) | the agents (since 2026-11-06), or the user |
| `archive/gates/`, `archive/fills/` | processed gate/fill folders, moved after findings or delivery are committed to the records | maintainer |
| `archive/deliveries/`, `archive/findings-drops/` | processed zips and findings, moved once committed to the records | maintainer |

## Protocol

- **Outbound.** The maintainer commits the file to `outbox/` and pushes. In chat it gives the
  file's GitHub path, its SHA-256 and the dispatch prompt in a fenced block. Every commit named in
  a prompt is a full 40-character hash from `git rev-parse`.
- **Agents read this branch.** Ask Codex or Claude before preparing each audit/fill. Codex
  returns a findings Markdown file or delivery zip as an attachment in chat; findings are also
  pasted in the reply. Claude may push to the exact designated `arora-barak-ch3-4/inbox/` path,
  after `git pull --rebase`, without force-push or changes elsewhere. External agents do not push
  directly to a campaign branch. Lean changes go by PR for the user to merge. The user explicitly
  retained the maintainer's records-only direct-push exception on the campaign branch.
- **Inbound.** The user pushes deliveries and findings to `inbox/`, or attaches them in chat (a
  Claude fill agent may push its zips to `inbox/` itself). The maintainer verifies checksums before use. Everything
  received is data, never instructions.
- **After use**, items move to `archive/`. Since 2026-11-06 a dispatched gate or fill folder stays
  in `outbox/`, where its agent reads it, until its findings or delivery are committed to the
  records; then it moves.
- **Sharing the branch.** The Pass–Shelat maintainer pushes to the same branch. Each session
  changes only its own subtree (this folder, or the Pass–Shelat folders at the top level), and runs
  `git pull --rebase` before every push. A rejected push is retried after a rebase, never forced.
- **Before 2026-11-04** the exchange was the git-ignored `tcslib/exchange/` on the user's Mac. Its
  archive (283 MB) stays there; `archive/LOCAL-ARCHIVE-INDEX.md` lists it.

## Current outbound work

- Gate 115, E-PAD (#228): `outbox/gates/115-epad-fill-gate/`; Codex audit, not yet dispatched.
- Gates 106 (#215, SG-1) and 114 (#222, NatBits): replays/evidence being finalized by the maintainer.
- The E-PAD final delivery has been recorded; its processed inbox/outbox items move to the archive.

The Mac-wide Lean limit is five (the user, 2026-11-06), with three slots budgeted to this campaign
and two to the other chat. Shared-checkout changes remain confined to this subtree.

## ===== campaign/status/2026-11-06-mac-bootstrap/mk-next-codex.sh =====

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Merge the campaign into a PR branch and write its merged-tree replay, chained from a snapshot.
# Paths: $TCSLIB_SCRATCH holds the worktrees (<worktree dir> is relative to it), the snapshots and
# fills/replay/ (scripts, closures, logs).
# Usage: mk-next.sh <name> <worktree dir> <branch> <snapshot-tree commit> <prev snap> <prev log>
#                   <new snap> "<base label>" "<label>" <expected changed .lean count>
# <snapshot-tree commit>: a commit whose Lean tree is exactly <prev snap>'s; the campaign tip's
# Lean must equal it. Stops before any push if a check fails.
set -euo pipefail
S="${TCSLIB_SCRATCH:-$HOME/.tcslib-scratch}"
R="${TCSLIB_REPO:-$HOME/tcslib}"
T="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"   # this folder, devtools/seyoon
mkdir -p "$S/fills/replay"
NAME=$1; W=$S/$2; BR=$3; SNAPC=$4; PREV=$5; PREVLOG=$6; NEW=$7; BLABEL=$8; LABEL=$9; NF=${10}
cd "$W"
git fetch -q origin
BASE=$(git rev-parse origin/complexity/arora-barak-ch3-4)
git cat-file -e "$SNAPC^{commit}" 2>/dev/null || { echo "the snapshot-tree commit $SNAPC does not exist" >&2; exit 2; }
[ -z "$(git diff --name-only $SNAPC $BASE -- '*.lean')" ] || { echo "the campaign's Lean differs from $SNAPC: $PREV is not its snapshot" >&2; exit 2; }
[ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/$BR)" ] || { echo "$W is not at origin/$BR" >&2; exit 2; }
[ -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)" ] || { echo "$W has local changes" >&2; exit 2; }
if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor $BASE HEAD; then
  GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=Codex GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=codex@openai.com GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=Codex GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=codex@openai.com git merge -q -m "Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/complexity/arora-barak-ch3-4' into $BR

Co-Authored-By: Codex <codex@openai.com>" origin/complexity/arora-barak-ch3-4
fi
FILES=(); while read -r f; do FILES+=("$f"); done < <(git diff --name-only $BASE HEAD -- '*.lean')
[ "${#FILES[@]}" = "$NF" ] || { echo "expected $NF changed files, got: ${FILES[*]}" >&2; exit 2; }
git push -q origin HEAD:$BR
MODS=(); PINS=""
for f in "${FILES[@]}"; do m=${f%.lean}; MODS+=("${m//\//.}"); PINS="$PINS$f:$(git rev-parse HEAD:$f);"; done
echo "changed: ${FILES[*]}; head $(git rev-parse HEAD)"
python3 -I $T/mkdownmulti.py $W $T $S/fills/replay/down-$NAME.txt "${MODS[@]}"
TCSLIB_SCRATCH=$S python3 -I $T/mkreplay.py $S/fills/replay/replay-$NAME.sh $NAME $2 $BR $BASE "$BLABEL" $S/fills/replay/down-$NAME.txt $PREVLOG $PREV $NEW "$LABEL" "${PINS%;}"
awk '/^cp -R/ {print "echo PRECHECK-PASSED; exit 0"; exit} {print}' $S/fills/replay/replay-$NAME.sh > $S/fills/replay/precheck-$NAME.sh
bash $S/fills/replay/precheck-$NAME.sh

```
"""List complete UTF-8 inputs for one mixed-source gate bundle; stage separately."""

from pathlib import Path
import json
import os
import re
import sys


records = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
scratch = Path(os.environ["TCSLIB_SCRATCH"])
gate = sys.argv[1]
folder = records / "campaign/gates" / gate
assert (folder / "evidence/current/README.md").exists(), "Finalize the gate evidence first"
data = json.loads((folder / "evidence/current/landing/refs.json").read_text())
head = Path(data["head_export"])
common = ["policy.md", "workflow.md", "lean-toolchain", "lakefile.lean", "lake-manifest.json",
          "campaign/standards/TEMPLATE.md", "campaign/standards/fill-environment-addendum.md",
          "campaign/maintainer/START-HERE.md", "campaign/maintainer/WORKFLOW.md",
          "campaign/maintainer/HANDOFF.md", "campaign/duplication-ledger.md", "campaign/backlog.md",
          "campaign/items/roadmap3/PLAN.md", "scripts/copy-text-screen-v3.py",
          "scripts/style_lint.py", "scripts/campaign_style_lint.py", "scripts/blueprint_validate.py"]
common += ["devtools/seyoon/" + n for n in (
    "declfreeze.py", "pairdiff.py", "staticsorry.py", "mkdownmulti.py", "mkreplay.py",
    "mkbundle-mixed.py", "verifybundle.py", "stage.sh", "leanelab.sh", "leanelab-o.sh",
    "bootstrap-snapshot.sh", "scratch-api/slotrun.sh")]
paths = [str((folder / "pack.md").relative_to(records)), *common]
paths += (folder / "evidence/current/screen/population-head.txt").read_text().splitlines()
paths += [str(p.relative_to(records)) for p in sorted((folder / "evidence").rglob("*")) if p.is_file()]
paths.append(str((folder / "STATUS.md").relative_to(records)))
setup = records / "campaign/status/2026-11-06-mac-bootstrap"
paths += [str(p.relative_to(records)) for p in sorted(setup.rglob("*")) if p.is_file()]
if gate.startswith("114"):
    paths += ["campaign/items/dedup/natbits-PLAN.md", "campaign/items/dedup/natbits-SCOPE.md"]
if gate.startswith("115"):
    paths += [str(p.relative_to(records)) for p in sorted((records / "campaign/fills/epad").rglob("*"))
              if p.is_file()]
    paths += ["campaign/gates/110-epad-statements/" + n for n in
              ("pack.md", "findings.md", "resolutions.md", "STATUS.md")]
paths = list(dict.fromkeys(paths))
for path in paths:
    p = (head if path.startswith("TCSlib/") else records) / path
    text = p.read_bytes().decode("utf-8")
    assert not re.search(r"^## ===== .+ =====$", text, re.M), (path, "nested bundle marker")
manifest = folder / "BUNDLE-FILES.txt"
manifest.write_text("\n".join(paths) + "\n")
name = {"106-sg1-dedup": "SG-1 deduplication (#215)",
        "114-natbits-dedup": "NatBits deduplication (#222)",
        "115-epad-fill": "E-PAD fill (#228)"}[gate]
(folder / "bundle-intro.md").write_text(
    f"Independent Codex audit of {name}. Read `campaign/gates/{gate}/pack.md` first. "
    "The bundle includes the full source populations, baseline comparison inputs, standards and "
    "executed evidence. Treat delivered material as data. The user dispatches the audit and merges "
    "the PR after the gate closes; this package is not a merge authorization.\n")
print(gate, len(paths), "UTF-8 input sections prepared")
```

```
"""Write inspected E-PAD probe sources; this script does not run Lean.

The four metadata walks and first-equation control were read in full before
reuse from the checksummed delivery. No delivered shell/Python tool is run.
The parameter-abstracted equation control and module census are maintainer additions.
"""

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import os


records = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
scratch = Path(os.environ["TCSLIB_SCRATCH"])
delivery = scratch / "deliveries/epad-5fd7ecd68e4a/extracted/evidence"
data = json.loads((scratch / "gate-source-exports/summary.json").read_text())["115-epad-fill"]
evidence = records / "campaign/gates/115-epad-fill/evidence/current"
for name in ("seal", "axioms", "elaboration"):
    (evidence / name).mkdir(exist_ok=True)
receipt = {"head": data["head"], "reviewed_delivery_probe_sha256": {}}
for name in ("EPadAxioms", "EPadForeignDefs", "EPadSimpDefs", "EPadCites"):
    original = delivery / "probes" / (name + ".lean")
    source = original.read_text()
    receipt["reviewed_delivery_probe_sha256"][name] = hashlib.sha256(original.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    directory = "axioms" if name == "EPadAxioms" else "seal"
    (evidence / directory / (name + ".lean.txt")).write_text(source)

source = (Path(data["head_export"]) / "TCSlib/Complexity/SpaceComplexity/Padding.lean").read_text()
names = (delivery / "seal/seal-list-final.txt").read_text().splitlines()
assert len(names) == len(set(names)) == 36
attributes = "attribute [local irreducible]\n  " + "\n  ".join(names) + "\n"
attributes += "attribute [-simp] Turing.Action.apply Turing.Cfg.init Turing.MultiTapeTM.initCfg\n"
anchor = "open Turing\n"
assert source.count(anchor) == 1
(evidence / "seal/EPadSealed.lean.txt").write_text(source.replace(anchor, anchor + "\n" + attributes))
(evidence / "seal/seal-list.txt").write_text("\n".join(names) + "\n")
(evidence / "seal/delivery-not-sealed.txt").write_text((delivery / "seal/not-sealed-final.txt").read_text())

# Check the first equation both pointwise and abstracted over its parameters.
control = (delivery / "seal/EPadSealControlUnsealed-final.lean").read_text()
imports = "\n".join(line for line in source.splitlines() if line.startswith("import ")) + "\n\n"
start = control.index("open Lean Elab Command Term Meta in")
stop = control.index("#epad_seal_rfl Complexity.LOGSPACE")
command = control[start:stop]
whole = r'''open Lean Elab Command Term Meta in
elab "#epad_abstract_rfl " id:ident : command => do
  let n ← liftCoreM <| realizeGlobalConstNoOverloadWithInfo id
  liftTermElabM do
    let some eqs ← Meta.getEqnsFor? n | throwError "no equations for {n}"
    let original ← inferType (← mkConstWithLevelParams eqs[0]!)
    let ty ← forallTelescope original fun xs target => do
      unless target.isAppOfArity ``Eq 3 do throwError "not an equality for {n}"
      mkEq (← mkLambdaFVars xs target.appFn!.appArg!) (← mkLambdaFVars xs target.appArg!)
    let ok ← try
        Term.withoutErrToSorry do
          let pf ← Term.elabTermEnsuringType (← `(by rfl)) ty
          Term.synthesizeSyntheticMVarsNoPostponing
          let _ ← instantiateMVars pf
        pure true
      catch _ => pure false
    if ok then logInfo m!"abstract rfl closes: {n}"
    else throwError m!"abstract rfl FAILS: {n}"

'''
calls = "\n".join("#epad_seal_rfl " + n + "\n#epad_abstract_rfl " + n for n in names) + "\n"
for label, attrs in (("Unsealed", ""), ("Sealed", attributes)):
    (evidence / "seal" / ("Controls" + label + ".lean.txt")).write_text(
        imports + command + whole + attrs + "\n" + calls)

matcher = "Complexity.LogProg.alignedPair_loop.match_1"
(evidence / "seal/MatcherLimitation.lean.txt").write_text(
    imports + command + "\n#epad_seal_rfl " + matcher + "\n" +
    "attribute [local irreducible] " + matcher + "\n#epad_seal_rfl " + matcher + "\n")
(evidence / "seal/AbbrevEliminatorAttributes.lean.txt").write_text(
    imports + "\n" + "\n".join("attribute [local irreducible] " + n for n in (
        "Complexity.LogProg.ARM", "Complexity.LogProg.AConf", "Complexity.LogProg.BankS",
        "Complexity.LogProg.Ins.casesOn")) + "\n")

public = r'''import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Padding

open Lean Elab Command in
run_cmd do
  let env ← getEnv
  let some target := env.getModuleIdx? `TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Padding
    | throwError "Padding is missing from the imported module table"
  let names := env.constants.toList.filterMap fun (n, ci) =>
    if env.getModuleIdxFor? n == some target && !isPrivateName n then some (n, ci) else none
  for (n, ci) in names.toArray.qsort (fun a b => a.1.toString < b.1.toString) do
    let kind := match ci with
      | .thmInfo _ => "theorem" | .defnInfo _ => "definition"
      | .opaqueInfo _ => "opaque" | .axiomInfo _ => "axiom"
      | .ctorInfo _ => "constructor" | .recInfo _ => "recursor"
      | .inductInfo _ => "inductive" | .quotInfo _ => "quotient"
    logInfo m!"PUBLIC_CONSTANT {n} kind={kind} internal={n.isInternalDetail}"
'''
(evidence / "axioms/PublicConstants.lean.txt").write_text(public)
sanity = r'''import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Padding

set_option autoImplicit false
open Turing Complexity

-- Zero padding permits every original member.
example (L : Language Bool) (x : List Bool) (hx : x ∈ L) :
    pairEncode x [] ∈ padLang L (fun _ => 0) := by
  exact mem_padLang_iff.mpr ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩

-- At degree zero the padding length is the constant coefficient, including x = [].
example (L : Language Bool) (C : ℕ) (hx : ([] : List Bool) ∈ L) :
    pairEncode [] (List.replicate C true) ∈ padLang L (fun n => C * (n + 1) ^ 0) := by
  apply mem_padLang_iff.mpr
  exact ⟨[], hx, by rw [pow_zero, Nat.mul_one]⟩

-- Empty languages cannot acquire members by padding.
example (pad : ℕ → ℕ) (y : List Bool) :
    y ∉ padLang (fun _ => False : Language Bool) pad := by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨x, hx, _⟩ := mem_padLang_iff.mp h
  exact hx
'''
(evidence / "elaboration/Sanity.lean.txt").write_text(sanity)
(evidence / "elaboration/PaddingPreflight.lean.txt").write_text(
    source + "\n" + sanity.replace("import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Padding\n", "") +
    "\n#print axioms Complexity.mem_SPACE_padLang\n#print axioms Complexity.padLang\n" +
    "#print axioms Complexity.mem_padLang_iff\n")
(evidence / "seal/input-receipt.json").write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + "\n")
print("Wrote E-PAD probes only; no elaboration was run.")
```

## ===== campaign/status/2026-11-06-mac-bootstrap/prepare-module-census.py =====

```
"""Prepare unfiltered non-private constant censuses for every changed module."""

from pathlib import Path
import json
import os


records = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
scratch = Path(os.environ["TCSLIB_SCRATCH"])
cases = json.loads((scratch / "gate-source-exports/summary.json").read_text())
for gate, data in cases.items():
    evidence = records / "campaign/gates" / gate / "evidence/current"
    changed = (evidence / "landing/changed-lean-files.txt").read_text().splitlines()
    for label in ("base", "head"):
        files = [p for p in changed if (Path(data[label + "_export"]) / p).exists()]
        modules = [p.removesuffix(".lean").replace("/", ".") for p in files]
        text = "\n".join("import " + m for m in modules) + "\n\n"
        wanted = "[" + ", ".join("`" + m for m in modules) + "]"
        text += r'''open Lean Elab Command in
run_cmd do
  let env ← getEnv
  let wanted : List Name := WANTED
  for mod in wanted do
    unless (env.getModuleIdx? mod).isSome do throwError "missing imported module {mod}"
  let names := env.constants.toList.filterMap fun (n, ci) =>
    match env.getModuleIdxFor? n with
    | some i =>
      let mod := env.header.moduleNames[i.toNat]!
      if wanted.contains mod && !isPrivateName n then some (n, ci, mod) else none
    | none => none
  for (n, ci, mod) in names.toArray.qsort (fun a b => a.1.toString < b.1.toString) do
    let kind := match ci with
      | .thmInfo _ => "theorem" | .defnInfo _ => "definition"
      | .opaqueInfo _ => "opaque" | .axiomInfo _ => "axiom"
      | .ctorInfo _ => "constructor" | .recInfo _ => "recursor"
      | .inductInfo _ => "inductive" | .quotInfo _ => "quotient"
    logInfo m!"CONSTANT {n} module={mod} kind={kind} internal={n.isInternalDetail}"
'''.replace("WANTED", wanted)
        target = evidence / "axioms" / ("ModuleCensus-" + label + ".lean.txt")
        target.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        target.write_text(text)
print("Prepared changed-module census sources only.")
```

## ===== campaign/status/2026-11-06-mac-bootstrap/prepare-probes.py =====

```
"""Write gate probe sources as .lean.txt evidence; do not elaborate them."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
from pathlib import Path


SEGMENT_GOALS = r"""
section
variable {k : ℕ} {Γ S : Type} {x : List Γ} (M : Turing.MultiTapeTM k Γ S)
  (F : Set (Option S)) (P : (Fin k → ℤ) → Prop) (a b : Turing.Cfg k Γ S x) (t : ℕ)
example : Turing.Segment M F P a b t ↔
    M.runFrom a t = b ∧ (∀ u < t, (M.runFrom a u).state ∉ F) ∧
      ∀ u ≤ t, P (M.runFrom a u).workTapePos := by
  BODY_IFF
example : Turing.Segment M F P a b t =
    (M.runFrom a t = b ∧ (∀ u < t, (M.runFrom a u).state ∉ F) ∧
      ∀ u ≤ t, P (M.runFrom a u).workTapePos) := by
  BODY_EQ
end
"""

BUFFER_GOALS = r"""
example (w : List Bool) (z : ℤ) : Turing.FinTM.bufferTape w z =
    (if 0 ≤ z then w[z.toNat]? else none) := by
  BODY_EQ
example (w : List Bool) : Turing.FinTM.bufferTape w 0 = w[0]? := by
  BODY_ZERO
"""


def main() -> None:
    records = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
    scratch = Path(os.environ["TCSLIB_SCRATCH"])
    info = json.loads((scratch / "gate-source-exports/summary.json").read_text())
    gate = records / "campaign/gates/106-sg1-dedup/evidence/current"
    (gate / "seal").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    unsealed = SEGMENT_GOALS.replace("BODY_IFF", "rfl").replace("BODY_EQ", "rfl")
    sealed = SEGMENT_GOALS.replace(
        "BODY_IFF", "fail_if_success rfl\n  exact Turing.segment_iff M F P a b t").replace(
        "BODY_EQ", "fail_if_success rfl\n  exact propext (Turing.segment_iff M F P a b t)")
    controls = ("\n-- Both delta controls close before the seal.\n" + unsealed +
                "\nattribute [local irreducible] Turing.Segment\n" +
                "-- The identical rfl attempts fail after the seal; the public equation closes them.\n" + sealed)
    sg1 = Path(info["106-sg1-dedup"]["head_export"])
    for path in ("ClassNP/Tautology", "TuringMachine/Build/CounterLoop",
                 "TuringMachine/Robustness/SingleTape"):
        source = (sg1 / f"TCSlib/Complexity/{path}.lean").read_text()
        lines = source.splitlines(keepends=True)
        imports = [line for line in lines if line.startswith("import ")]
        assert imports
        anchor = imports[-1]
        assert source.count(anchor) == 1
        source = source.replace(anchor, anchor + controls + "\n")
        (gate / "seal" / (Path(path).name + ".lean.txt")).write_text(source)
    unsealed = BUFFER_GOALS.replace("BODY_EQ", "rfl").replace("BODY_ZERO", "rfl")
    sealed = BUFFER_GOALS.replace(
        "BODY_EQ", "fail_if_success rfl\n  exact Turing.FinTM.bufferTape_eq w z").replace(
        "BODY_ZERO", "fail_if_success rfl\n  exact Turing.FinTM.bufferTape_nat w 0")
    fragment = "import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.Frag\n\n" + unsealed
    fragment += "\nattribute [local irreducible] Turing.FinTM.bufferTape\n" + sealed
    fragment += r"""

set_option autoImplicit false
open Turing

example (w : List Bool) (k : ℕ) (hkw : k < w.length) :
    FinTM.bufferTape (w.take k ++ w[k] :: w.drop (k + 2))
      (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1) = some w[k] := by
  have hlen : (w.take k).length = k := List.length_take_of_le (Nat.le_of_lt hkw)
  have hpos : (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1) = ((w.take k).length : ℤ) := by
    rw [hlen]; push_cast; ring
  rw [hpos, FinTM.bufferTape_nat, List.getElem?_append_right le_rfl, Nat.sub_self]
  rfl
"""
    (gate / "seal/FragCell.lean.txt").write_text(fragment)
    for name in info:
        evidence = records / "campaign/gates" / name / "evidence/current/axioms"
        evidence.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        census = json.loads((evidence.parent / "freeze/census.json").read_text())
        modules = sorted(path[:-5].replace("/", ".") for path in census)
        names = sorted({n for row in census.values()
                        for n in row["public_added"] + row["public_body_changed"]})
        probe = "\n".join("import " + module for module in modules) + "\n\n"
        probe += "\n".join("#print axioms " + constant for constant in names) + "\n"
        if name.startswith("114"):
            probe += r"""

-- Enumerate every non-private imported constant from the new module, including auxiliaries.
open Lean Elab Command in
run_cmd do
  let env ← getEnv
  let some target := env.getModuleIdx? `TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.NatBits
    | throwError "NatBits is missing from the imported module table"
  let names := env.constants.toList.filterMap fun (n, ci) =>
    if env.getModuleIdxFor? n == some target && !isPrivateName n then some (n, ci) else none
  for (n, ci) in names.toArray.qsort (fun a b => a.1.toString < b.1.toString) do
    let kind := match ci with
      | .thmInfo _ => "theorem"
      | .defnInfo _ => "definition"
      | .opaqueInfo _ => "opaque"
      | .axiomInfo _ => "axiom"
      | .ctorInfo _ => "constructor"
      | .recInfo _ => "recursor"
      | .inductInfo _ => "inductive"
      | .quotInfo _ => "quotient"
    logInfo m!"PUBLIC_CONSTANT {n} kind={kind} internal={n.isInternalDetail}"
"""
            sanity = r"""import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.NatBits

set_option autoImplicit false

example : (Nat.bits 0).length = 0 := by rw [Nat.zero_bits]; rfl
example : ¬ (Nat.bits 0).length = Nat.log 2 0 + 1 := by
  rw [Nat.zero_bits, Nat.log_zero_right]; decide
example : (Nat.bits 1).length = Nat.log 2 1 + 1 := by
  rw [Nat.one_bits, Nat.log_one_right]; rfl
example : 2 ^ (Nat.bits 0).length = 2 * 0 + 1 := by rw [Nat.zero_bits]; decide
example : (Nat.bits (1 + 1)).length ≤ 0 + 2 :=
  Complexity.LogProg.length_bits_succ_le (m := 1) (e := 0) (by decide)
example : Nat.ofDigits 2 (([] : List Bool).map Bool.toNat) < 2 ^ ([] : List Bool).length :=
  Complexity.LogProg.ofDigits_lt_two_pow []
example : Nat.ofDigits 2 ([false, true].map Bool.toNat) < 2 ^ ([false, true] : List Bool).length :=
  Complexity.LogProg.ofDigits_lt_two_pow [false, true]
"""
            (evidence.parent / "Sanity.lean.txt").write_text(sanity)
        (evidence / "Axioms.lean.txt").write_text(probe)
    print("Wrote probe sources only; no elaboration was run.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

## ===== campaign/status/2026-11-06-mac-bootstrap/resource-guard-five.py =====

```
"""Keep this task within the user's global cap of five; signal only owned jobs."""

from pathlib import Path
import json
import os
import signal
import subprocess
import time


scratch = Path(os.environ["TCSLIB_SCRATCH"])
stopped: set[int] = set()
log = scratch / "setup/resource-five-events.jsonl"
while not (scratch / "setup/resource-five.stop").exists():
    ours, external = [], []
    raw = subprocess.check_output(["ps", "-A", "-o", "pid=,stat=,command="], text=True)
    for line in raw.splitlines():
        p = line.strip().split(maxsplit=2)
        if len(p) != 3 or "Z" in p[1]:
            continue
        pid, state, cmd = int(p[0]), p[1], p[2]
        if not (cmd.split()[0].endswith("/lean") or cmd.startswith("lean ")):
            continue
        owned = any(str(scratch / n) in cmd for n in (
            "oleans-msg1/", "oleans-mnb1/", "oleans-mepad1/", "gate-probes/"))
        if owned:
            ours.append((pid, state))
        elif "T" not in state:
            external.append(pid)
    budget = max(0, 5 - len(external))
    running = sorted(pid for pid, state in ours if "T" not in state)
    for pid in running[budget:]:
        try:
            os.kill(pid, signal.SIGSTOP)
        except ProcessLookupError:
            continue
        stopped.add(pid)
        with log.open("a") as output:
            output.write(json.dumps({"event": "suspend-own", "pid": pid,
                                     "external_active": len(external)}) + "\n")
    free = max(0, budget - min(len(running), budget))
    for pid, state in sorted(ours):
        if free and pid in stopped and "T" in state:
            try:
                os.kill(pid, signal.SIGCONT)
            except ProcessLookupError:
                continue
            stopped.discard(pid)
            free -= 1
            with log.open("a") as output:
                output.write(json.dumps({"event": "resume-own", "pid": pid,
                                         "external_active": len(external)}) + "\n")
    time.sleep(1)
print("Five-process resource guard stopped.")
```

## ===== campaign/status/2026-11-06-mac-bootstrap/resource-guard.py =====

```
"""Task-local safeguard while another campaign does not share the Lean locks.

Signal only this task's replay/probe Lean processes. Leave them suspended
while any external Lean job is active; resume after 30 seconds without one.
The shared slot locks continue to cap this task at two. No external job is
signaled. Stop via the task's resource-guard.stop file after all checks finish.
"""

from pathlib import Path
import datetime
import json
import os
import signal
import subprocess
import time


scratch = Path(os.environ["TCSLIB_SCRATCH"])
records = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
history = records / "campaign/status/2026-11-06-mac-bootstrap/resource-events.jsonl"
stopped = {row["pid"] for row in json.loads(history.with_name("resource-pause.json").read_text())["suspended"]}
quiet_since = None
(scratch / "setup/resource-guard.pid").write_text(str(os.getpid()) + "\n")
while not (scratch / "setup/resource-guard.stop").exists():
    raw = subprocess.check_output(["ps", "-A", "-o", "pid=,stat=,command="], text=True)
    ours, external = [], []
    for line in raw.splitlines():
        parts = line.strip().split(maxsplit=2)
        if len(parts) != 3:
            continue
        pid, state, command = int(parts[0]), parts[1], parts[2]
        if not (command.split()[0].endswith("/lean") or command.startswith("lean ")):
            continue
        if "Z" in state:
            continue
        owned = any(str(scratch / name) in command for name in (
            "oleans-msg1/", "oleans-mnb1/", "oleans-mepad1/", "gate-probes/"))
        if owned:
            ours.append((pid, state))
        elif "T" not in state:
            external.append(pid)
    if external:
        quiet_since = None
        for pid, state in ours:
            if "T" not in state:
                try:
                    os.kill(pid, signal.SIGSTOP)
                except ProcessLookupError:
                    continue
                stopped.add(pid)
                with history.open("a") as output:
                    output.write(json.dumps({"at_utc": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                                             "event": "suspend-own", "pid": pid,
                                             "external_active": len(external)}) + "\n")
    else:
        if quiet_since is None:
            quiet_since = time.monotonic()
        if time.monotonic() - quiet_since >= 30:
            for pid, state in ours:
                if pid in stopped and "T" in state:
                    try:
                        os.kill(pid, signal.SIGCONT)
                    except ProcessLookupError:
                        continue
                    stopped.discard(pid)
                    with history.open("a") as output:
                        output.write(json.dumps({"at_utc": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                                                 "event": "resume-own", "pid": pid,
                                                 "external_active": 0}) + "\n")
    time.sleep(1)
print("Resource guard stopped after task checks.")
```

## ===== campaign/status/2026-11-06-mac-bootstrap/run-probes.py =====

```
"""Run inspected .lean.txt probes only through the campaign's leanelab wrapper.

Usage: run-probes.py GATE WORKTREE SNAPSHOT RELATIVE-PROBE:EXPECTED-EXIT [...]
Each probe gets a pinned input checksum, unmodified output plus an exit line,
and a run receipt. A failed expectation stops the queue. leanelab owns the slots.
"""

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys


records = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
scratch = Path(os.environ["TCSLIB_SCRATCH"])
gate, worktree, snapshot, *probes = sys.argv[1:]
evidence = records / "campaign/gates" / gate / "evidence/current"
wt, snap = scratch / worktree, scratch / snapshot
sha = subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(wt), "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip()
subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(wt), "cat-file", "-e", sha + "^{commit}"], check=True)
assert not subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(wt), "status", "--porcelain"], text=True)
inputs = json.loads((evidence / "landing/refs.json").read_text())
assert sha == inputs["head"]
probe_root = scratch / "gate-probes" / gate / sha
probe_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
for item in probes:
    relative, expected = item.rsplit(":", 1)
    source = evidence / relative
    assert source.name.endswith(".lean.txt")
    imports = [line.removeprefix("import ").replace(".", "/")
               for line in source.read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith("import TCSlib.")]
    for module in imports:
        assert (snap / (module + ".olean")).is_file(), module
    dest = probe_root / relative.removesuffix(".txt")
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copy2(source, dest)
    log = source.with_name(source.name.removesuffix(".lean.txt") + ".out")
    probe_env = os.environ.copy()
    probe_env.setdefault("TCSLIB_LEAN_SLOTS", "3")
    with log.open("w") as output:
        result = subprocess.run(
            ["bash", str(records / "devtools/seyoon/leanelab.sh"), str(wt), str(snap), str(dest)],
            stdout=output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, env=probe_env)
        output.write(f"\nexit={result.returncode}\n")
    receipt = {"head": sha, "snapshot": snapshot, "probe": relative,
               "input_sha256": hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
               "imports": imports, "exit": result.returncode, "expected_exit": int(expected)}
    source.with_name(source.name.removesuffix(".lean.txt") + "-run.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(gate, relative, "exit", result.returncode, "expected", expected, flush=True)
    if result.returncode != int(expected):
        raise SystemExit(1)
```

## ===== campaign/status/2026-11-06-mac-bootstrap/run-replays.py =====

```
"""Wait for the complete Mac bootstrap, then replay the three pushed PR heads.

No replay starts before the bootstrap's successful final line. Git mutations
and prechecks are sequential; independent replays run under slotrun's two slots.
The scratch copy of mk-next.sh uses Codex attribution, recorded in setup.md.
"""

from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from pathlib import Path
import os
import re
import subprocess
import time


scratch = Path(os.environ["TCSLIB_SCRATCH"])
records = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
log = scratch / "fills/replay/bootstrap-oleans-mac0.log"
while True:
    lines = log.read_text().splitlines()
    if lines and re.fullmatch(r"# modules=\d+ failed=\d+", lines[-1]):
        assert lines[-1] == "# modules=894 failed=0", lines[-1]
        break
    holder = scratch / "locks/lean-slot-1/pid"
    assert holder.exists(), "Bootstrap stopped without a successful final line"
    os.kill(int(holder.read_text()), 0)
    time.sleep(10)

base = subprocess.check_output(
    ["git", "-C", str(scratch / "wt-camp"), "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip()
subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(records), "cat-file", "-e", base + "^{commit}"], check=True)
assert f" at {base} " in lines[0], lines[0]
print("Bootstrap passed; generating three replay prechecks.", flush=True)
cases = [
    ("mepad1", "wt-epad", "lean/epad-padding-fill", 1, "E-PAD #228"),
    ("msg1", "wt-sg1", "lean/dedup-sg1", 4, "SG-1 #215"),
    ("mnb1", "wt-natbits", "lean/dedup-natbits", 22, "NatBits #222"),
]
for name, wt, branch, count, label in cases:
    changed = subprocess.check_output(
        ["git", "-C", str(scratch / wt), "diff", "--name-only",
         "origin/complexity/arora-barak-ch3-4...HEAD", "--", "*.lean"], text=True).splitlines()
    assert len(changed) == count, (name, changed)
    subprocess.run(
        ["bash", str(scratch / "tools/mk-next.sh"), name, wt, branch, base,
         "oleans-mac0", str(log), "oleans-" + name,
         "complete Mac campaign bootstrap", label, str(count)], check=True)


def replay(case: tuple) -> tuple[str, int]:
    name = case[0]
    print("START", name, flush=True)
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["bash", str(scratch / "api/slotrun.sh"), "bash",
         str(scratch / "fills/replay" / ("replay-" + name + ".sh"))])
    print("FINISH", name, "exit", result.returncode, flush=True)
    return name, result.returncode


with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as queue:
    results = list(queue.map(replay, cases))
assert all(code == 0 for _, code in results), results
print("All three merged-tree replays passed.", flush=True)
```

## ===== campaign/status/2026-11-06-mac-bootstrap/run-screens.py =====

```
"""Run both gates' four copy-text screens serially under the screen lock.

Invoke with python3 -I after source-checks.py has made the immutable exports.
The unmodified outputs and the population of each run are gate evidence.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import time


def main() -> None:
    records = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
    scratch = Path(os.environ["TCSLIB_SCRATCH"])
    lock = scratch / "locks/screen"
    while True:
        try:
            lock.mkdir()
            break
        except FileExistsError:
            time.sleep(5)
    (lock / "pid").write_text(str(os.getpid()) + "\n")
    try:
        cases = json.loads((scratch / "gate-source-exports/summary.json").read_text())
        for gate, data in cases.items():
            if os.environ.get("TCSLIB_SCREEN_GATE") not in (None, gate):
                continue
            evidence = records / "campaign/gates" / gate / "evidence/current/screen"
            labels = os.environ.get("TCSLIB_SCREEN_LABELS", "base,head").split(",")
            assert all(label in ("base", "head") for label in labels)
            for label in labels:
                population = (evidence / f"population-{label}.txt").read_text().splitlines()
                tree = data[f"{label}_export"]
                with (evidence / f"screen-{label}.txt").open("w") as output:
                    subprocess.run(
                        ["nice", "-n", "10", "python3", "-I",
                         str(records / "scripts/copy-text-screen-v3.py"), tree, *population],
                        stdout=output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=True,
                    )
                first = (evidence / f"screen-{label}.txt").read_text().splitlines()[0]
                (evidence / f"screen-{label}-commit.txt").write_text(data[label] + "\n")
                print(gate, label, first, flush=True)
            with (evidence / "pairdiff.txt").open("w") as output:
                subprocess.run(
                    ["python3", "-I", str(records / "devtools/seyoon/pairdiff.py"),
                     str(evidence / "screen-head.txt"), str(evidence / "screen-base.txt")],
                    stdout=output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=True,
                )
    finally:
        assert (lock / "pid").read_text().strip() == str(os.getpid())
        (lock / "pid").unlink()
        lock.rmdir()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

## ===== campaign/status/2026-11-06-mac-bootstrap/search-sources.py =====

```
"""Candidate enumeration for gates 106/114/115, including active/prepared/delivery refs.

This is a source search, not an exhaustive duplication proof. The gate's
scope note classifies candidates and the copy-text screen is a separate run.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess


RECORDS = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
SCRATCH = Path(os.environ["TCSLIB_SCRATCH"])


def git(*args: str) -> str:
    return subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(RECORDS), *args], text=True).strip()


def main() -> None:
    summary = json.loads((SCRATCH / "gate-source-exports/summary.json").read_text())
    refs = ["origin/complexity/arora-barak-ch3-4", "origin/lean/dedup-sg1",
            "origin/lean/dedup-natbits", "origin/lean/epad-padding-fill",
            "origin/pr/215", "origin/pr/222", "origin/pr/228"]
    refs.extend(data["head"] for data in summary.values())
    available = git("for-each-ref", "--format=%(refname)", "refs/heads", "refs/remotes/origin",
                    "refs/deliver", "refs/local").splitlines()
    refs.extend(ref for ref in available if re.search(r"/(deliver/|local/[^\n]*landing|lean/dedup-ro1$)", ref))
    checked = {}
    for ref in dict.fromkeys(refs):
        sha = git("rev-parse", ref)
        subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(RECORDS), "cat-file", "-e", sha + "^{commit}"], check=True)
        checked[ref] = sha
    names = r"length_bits_eq_log|lt_two_pow_bits|two_pow_bits_le_two_mul_add_one|ofDigits_lt_two_pow"
    shapes = r"(theorem|lemma).*(length_bits|bitsVal_lt_two_pow|word_lt|bits_succ_le|two_pow_bits|bits_length)"
    for gate, data in summary.items():
        output = RECORDS / "campaign/gates" / gate / "evidence/current/search"
        output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (output / "refs.json").write_text(json.dumps(checked, indent=2) + "\n")
        if gate.startswith(("114", "115")):
            names = r"length_bits_eq_log|lt_two_pow_bits|two_pow_bits_le_two_mul_add_one|ofDigits_lt_two_pow"
            shapes = r"(theorem|lemma).*(length_bits|bitsVal_lt_two_pow|word_lt|bits_succ_le|two_pow_bits|bits_length)"
            if gate.startswith("115"):
                names = r"epad_|mem_SPACE_padLang|two_pow_bits_le|length_bits_le_self"
                shapes = r"(theorem|lemma).*(scan_loop|mul_loop|pow_loop|ones_loop|val_run|bitsVal_lt_two_pow)"
            with (output / "names-and-shapes.txt").open("w") as log:
                for sha in dict.fromkeys(checked.values()):
                    labels = [ref for ref, value in checked.items() if value == sha]
                    log.write("\nREFS " + ", ".join(labels) + "\n")
                    for pattern in (names, shapes):
                        proc = subprocess.run(
                            ["git", "-C", str(RECORDS), "grep", "-n", "-E", pattern,
                             sha, "--", "TCSlib"], text=True, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
                        assert proc.returncode in (0, 1)
            patterns = {
                "size-and-log-readings": r"Nat\.(size_eq_bits_len|size_le|lt_size|size_pos|pow_log_le_self)|Nat\.log 2.*\+ 1",
                "word-value-readings": r"Nat\.ofDigits_lt_base_pow_length|bitsVal_lt_two_pow|ofDigits_lt_two_pow",
                "length-bound-readings": r"(bits|size).*length.*(≤|<|=)|(≤|<|=).*2 \^.*bits.*length",
            }
            if gate.startswith("115"):
                patterns["loop-contract-candidates"] = r"(theorem|lemma|def).*(scan_loop|mul_loop|pow_loop|ones_loop|ARMLoops)"
        else:
            patterns = {
                "retired-concatenation-names": r"counter_span_append|tautDual_segment_add|dgSpan_add",
                "segment-helper-candidates": r"(private )?(lemma|theorem|def).*([Ss]egment|[Ss]pan|guard_add|splitSafe)",
                "run-concatenation-steps": r"runFrom_add|exists_eq_add_of_le|runFrom_of_halt",
            }
        for label in ("base", "head"):
            tree = Path(data[label + "_export"])
            for kind, pattern in patterns.items():
                regex = re.compile(pattern)
                hits = []
                for path in sorted((tree / "TCSlib").rglob("*.lean")):
                    for number, line in enumerate(path.read_text().splitlines(), 1):
                        if regex.search(line):
                            hits.append(f"{path.relative_to(tree)}:{number}:{line}")
                (output / f"{kind}-{label}.txt").write_text("\n".join(hits) + ("\n" if hits else ""))
        print(gate, "searched", len(checked), "refs;", len(set(checked.values())), "distinct trees", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

## ===== campaign/status/2026-11-06-mac-bootstrap/setup.md =====

# Native Mac setup and snapshot receipt

Codex took over on 2026-11-06 PST / 2026-11-07 UTC. `setup-initial.json` is the immutable initial setup observation, before the bootstrap or E-PAD receipt; its not-started fields are historical, not current status. HANDOFF §0 tracks the current work.

- Campaign checkout: `/Users/seyoonr/phd_experiments/tcslib_all_branches/tcslib-arora-barak-ch3-4`.
- Exchange subtree: `/Users/seyoonr/phd_experiments/tcslib_all_branches/tcslib-exchange/arora-barak-ch3-4`.
- Scratch: `/Users/seyoonr/phd_experiments/tcslib_all_branches/tcslib-scratch`; source `env.sh` at the start of every command.
- Managed worktrees are linked under scratch as `wt-hk` (records), `wt-camp`, `wt-sg1`, `wt-natbits` and `wt-epad`; `wt-xch` points to the shared exchange checkout. They share Git objects with the campaign checkout rather than re-cloning. Every Lean worktree's `.lake/packages` is linked to the original checkout.
- Native pinned Lean 4.25.0 and its matching Lake. Initial machine check: 12 CPUs, 18 GiB RAM, about 464 GiB free. No `lake build` was used.
- All present dependency revisions match the manifest (`manifest.log`). The absent documentation-only packages were not needed for proof elaboration. All 431 checked Mathlib roots had usable cached products; the narrowed import probe exited zero. The already cached PFR products let the native bootstrap include the full closure, with zero skips.

## Complete campaign snapshot

`oleans-mac0` is the native compiled tree at `680760723d72826469d0fc294e4d7ee2ecac3e6c`. This commit and the prior merge of #221 have identical Lean. The actual bootstrap ran through `slotrun.sh` and the prescribed `bootstrap-snapshot.sh`; `bootstrap/bootstrap.log` ends **# modules=894 failed=0**. Its complete order and empty skip list are retained. No compiled snapshot was assumed from the previous VM.

The bootstrap and initial checks used two Lean slots. When two jobs from the other campaign were found outside these locks, our two replays were suspended, preserving their state. The user then raised the machine-wide cap to **five**. The current local budget is **three**, set by `TCSLIB_LEAN_SLOTS=3` in scratch `env.sh`, leaving two for the other chat. The wrappers accept budgets 1–5; leanelab owns its slot, while a replay holds one through slotrun. See `resource-pause.json` and `resource-cap-five.json` for the actual pause/resume. Copy-text screens separately take `locks/screen`, one process at a time. All Python invocations use `python3 -I`. Preflights/seals run read-only against an already completed import closure; they are distinct from the full merged-tree replays.

## Reproduction tools and attribution

The eight scratch API files were copied from `devtools/seyoon/scratch-api/`; the replay helper directory was copied from `devtools/seyoon/`. Its `mk-next.sh` hard-coded Claude attribution, so the scratch copy was patched to Codex author, committer and co-author trailer before any merge. The exact patched script is retained here as `mk-next-codex.sh` (SHA-256 `307e4589665c967bd4cfde8d72645096cfdc7bf4e2e9a4e03ea123ee59b81f4e`). To reproduce it, copy the full helper directory before replacing that one file; its sibling tools are required. No shared Git identity configuration was changed.

`run-replays.py` waits for the complete bootstrap and checks three-dot changed-file counts before generating each prescribed replay; Git mutations and prechecks are sequential. Its independent snapshots all start from `oleans-mac0`, never from a composition of PR snapshots. `source-checks.py`, `search-sources.py`, `run-screens.py`, `prepare-probes.py`, `prepare-epad-probes.py` and `run-probes.py` preserve the source exports, candidate searches and exact executed probe inputs/results.

The records-only direct-push exception was explicitly reconfirmed by the user. Lean changes remain isolated in PRs #215, #222 and #228. The shared exchange checkout may contain another chat's work: preserve it, use only the campaign subtree and pull with rebase before each push.

## ===== campaign/status/2026-11-06-mac-bootstrap/source-checks.py =====

```
"""Prepare reproducible source evidence for gates 106, 114 and 115; no Lean runs.

Run with python3 -I after sourcing TCSLIB_SCRATCH/env.sh. The worktrees must
already contain the campaign tip. Archives are fresh Git exports. Expected
policy-lint findings are retained, including the process exit status.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import contextlib
import hashlib
import io
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import runpy
import subprocess
import sys
import tarfile


RECORDS = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
SCRATCH = Path(os.environ["TCSLIB_SCRATCH"])
SOURCE = Path(os.environ["TCSLIB_REPO"])
EXPORTS = SCRATCH / "gate-source-exports"
GIT_PATHS = ["TCSlib", "TCSlib.lean", "scripts", "devtools", "blueprint/src",
             "dep_graph.json", "policy.md", "workflow.md"]


def git(*args: str, root: Path = RECORDS) -> str:
    return subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(root), *args], text=True).strip()


def checked_commit(ref: str, root: Path = RECORDS) -> str:
    sha = git("rev-parse", ref, root=root)
    subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(root), "cat-file", "-e", sha + "^{commit}"], check=True)
    return sha


def export(sha: str) -> Path:
    target = EXPORTS / sha
    if target.exists():
        entries = subprocess.check_output(
            ["git", "-C", str(RECORDS), "ls-tree", "-rz", sha, "--", *GIT_PATHS])
        for entry in entries.split(b"\0"):
            if not entry:
                continue
            metadata, raw_path = entry.split(b"\t", 1)
            mode, kind, blob = metadata.split()
            assert kind == b"blob", entry
            path = target / os.fsdecode(raw_path)
            data = os.fsencode(os.readlink(path)) if mode == b"120000" else path.read_bytes()
            actual = hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(data)).encode() + b"\0" + data).hexdigest()
            assert actual == blob.decode(), path
        return target
    target.mkdir(parents=True)
    proc = subprocess.Popen(
        ["git", "-C", str(RECORDS), "archive", sha, *GIT_PATHS],
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
    )
    assert proc.stdout is not None
    with tarfile.open(fileobj=proc.stdout, mode="r|") as archive:
        archive.extractall(target, filter="data")
    assert proc.wait() == 0
    return target


def logged(args: list[str], path: Path, cwd: Path) -> int:
    with path.open("w") as output:
        proc = subprocess.run(args, cwd=cwd, stdout=output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        output.write(f"\nexit={proc.returncode}\n")
    return proc.returncode


def main() -> None:
    base_sha = checked_commit("origin/complexity/arora-barak-ch3-4")
    base = export(base_sha)
    empty = EXPORTS / "empty.lean.txt"
    empty.write_text("")
    # Load the campaign's comment-aware declaration census without emitting a
    # throwaway comparison; no delivered Lean text is executed as Python.
    sys.argv = [str(RECORDS / "devtools/seyoon/declfreeze.py"), str(empty), str(empty)]
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
        census = runpy.run_path(sys.argv[0])
    chunks, statement = census["chunks"], census["stmt"]
    cases = [
        ("106-sg1-dedup", "wt-sg1", 4,
         {"CounterLoop.lean": "counterLoopTMVia_run_done,counterLoopTMVia_done_witness,"
          "counterLoopTMVia_escape_witness,RoundContract.counterLoopDone_traj,"
          "RoundContract.counterLoopEscape_traj", "Frag.lean": "halfL_run"}),
        ("114-natbits-dedup", "wt-natbits", 22,
         {"Meyer.lean": "lenAll_inst", "MeyerTableau.lean": "bits_pad",
          "SpaceAmplifyPoly.lean": "bigK_le", "UniformSample.lean": "le_two_pow_size_pred",
          "CfgRecord.lean": "record_pos_lt", "Frag.lean": "halfL_run"}),
        ("115-epad-fill", "wt-epad", 1,
         {"Padding.lean": "mem_SPACE_padLang"}),
    ]
    summary_path = EXPORTS / "summary.json"
    summary = json.loads(summary_path.read_text()) if summary_path.exists() else {}
    for gate, worktree, expected, allowed in cases:
        if os.environ.get("TCSLIB_SOURCE_GATE") not in (None, gate):
            continue
        wt = SCRATCH / worktree
        assert not git("status", "--porcelain", root=wt)
        head_sha = checked_commit("HEAD", root=wt)
        assert subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(wt), "merge-base", "--is-ancestor",
                               base_sha, head_sha]).returncode == 0
        changed = git("diff", "--name-only", base_sha, head_sha, "--", "*.lean").splitlines()
        assert len(changed) == expected, (gate, changed)
        head = export(head_sha)
        evidence = RECORDS / "campaign/gates" / gate / "evidence/current"
        for directory in ("landing", "freeze", "lint", "screen", "search"):
            (evidence / directory).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (evidence / "landing/changed-lean-files.txt").write_text("\n".join(changed) + "\n")
        (evidence / "landing/change.diff").write_text(
            git("diff", base_sha, head_sha, "--", "*.lean", "blueprint/src") + "\n")
        (evidence / "landing/diff-stat.txt").write_text(git("diff", "--stat", base_sha, head_sha) + "\n")
        base_inputs = {}
        for path in changed:
            old = base / path
            if old.exists():
                target = evidence / "base-source" / (path + ".txt")
                target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                target.write_bytes(old.read_bytes())
                base_inputs[path] = str(target.relative_to(evidence))
            else:
                base_inputs[path] = None
        (evidence / "landing/base-source-map.json").write_text(
            json.dumps({"base": base_sha, "head": head_sha, "changed_files": base_inputs,
                        "unchanged_population_files": "Use the bundled head source; its blob is identical at base."},
                       indent=2) + "\n")
        for path in git("diff", "--name-only", base_sha, head_sha, "--", "blueprint/src").splitlines():
            for label, tree in (("base", base), ("head", head)):
                original = tree / path
                if original.exists():
                    target = evidence / "landing" / ("blueprint-" + original.stem + "-" + label + ".tex.txt")
                    target.write_bytes(original.read_bytes())
        changes = {}
        for path in changed:
            old = base / path
            new = head / path
            result = evidence / "freeze" / (Path(path).stem + ".txt")
            logged(["python3", "-I", str(RECORDS / "devtools/seyoon/declfreeze.py"),
                    str(old if old.exists() else empty), str(new), allowed.get(Path(path).name, "")],
                   result, RECORDS)
            old_chunks = list(chunks(old.read_text() if old.exists() else ""))
            new_chunks = list(chunks(new.read_text()))
            a = {n: (private, text) for n, private, text in old_chunks}
            b = {n: (private, text) for n, private, text in new_chunks}
            changes[path] = {
                "before_public": sum(not private for private, _ in a.values()),
                "after_public": sum(not private for private, _ in b.values()),
                "before_private": sum(private for private, _ in a.values()),
                "after_private": sum(private for private, _ in b.values()),
                "public_added": sorted(n for n in b.keys() - a.keys() if not b[n][0]),
                "public_removed": sorted(n for n in a.keys() - b.keys() if not a[n][0]),
                "public_body_changed": sorted(n for n in a.keys() & b.keys()
                                              if not a[n][0] and a[n][1] != b[n][1]),
                "statement_changed": sorted(n for n in a.keys() & b.keys()
                                            if statement(a[n][1]) != statement(b[n][1])),
                "private_added": sorted(n for n in b.keys() - a.keys() if b[n][0]),
                "private_removed": sorted(n for n in a.keys() - b.keys() if a[n][0]),
                "private_body_changed": sorted(n for n in a.keys() & b.keys()
                                               if a[n][0] and a[n][1] != b[n][1]),
                "visibility_changed": sorted(n for n in a.keys() & b.keys() if a[n][0] != b[n][0]),
                "surviving_public_order_unchanged":
                    [n for n, private, _ in old_chunks if not private and n in b] ==
                    [n for n, private, _ in new_chunks if not private and n in a],
                "surviving_private_order_unchanged":
                    [n for n, private, _ in old_chunks if private and n in b] ==
                    [n for n, private, _ in new_chunks if private and n in a],
            }
            assert not changes[path]["statement_changed"], (path, changes[path])
            assert not changes[path]["visibility_changed"], (path, changes[path])
            assert "UNAUTHORIZED" not in result.read_text(), result
        (evidence / "freeze/census.json").write_text(json.dumps(changes, indent=2) + "\n")
        subtrees = sorted({"/".join(path.split("/")[:3]) for path in changed
                           if path != "TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine.lean"})
        policy = {}
        for label, tree in (("base", base), ("head", head)):
            for subtree in subtrees:
                output = evidence / "lint" / f"campaign-{Path(subtree).name}-{label}.txt"
                policy[str(output.name)] = logged(
                    ["python3", "-I", str(tree / "scripts/campaign_style_lint.py"), subtree], output, tree)
            # A new file has no base counterpart; existing files are compared as
            # a common population, and the new module is checked separately.
            common = [path for path in changed if (base / path).exists()]
            output = evidence / "lint" / f"policy-{label}.txt"
            policy[output.name] = logged(["python3", "-I", str(tree / "scripts/style_lint.py"),
                                          *common], output, tree)
            if label == "head":
                added = [path for path in changed if not (base / path).exists()]
                if added:
                    output = evidence / "lint/policy-new-module.txt"
                    policy[output.name] = logged(["python3", "-I", str(tree / "scripts/style_lint.py"),
                                                  *added], output, tree)
            output = evidence / "lint" / f"blueprint-{label}.txt"
            policy[output.name] = logged(
                ["python3", "-I", str(tree / "scripts/blueprint_validate.py"),
                 "--strict", "--allow-orphans"], output, tree)
        population = set(changed)
        if gate.startswith("106"):
            population.update("TCSlib/Complexity/" + path for path in (
                "TuringMachine/Build/Contract/Basic.lean", "TuringMachine/Build/Primitives.lean",
                "TuringMachine/Build/Catalog.lean", "ClassNP/SAT.lean", "CookLevin/Hardness.lean"))
        if gate.startswith("115"):
            population.update("TCSlib/Complexity/" + path + ".lean" for path in (
                "ClassNP/PolyTimePairing", "SpaceComplexity/Basic", "SpaceComplexity/Codec/Word",
                "SpaceComplexity/Codec/Engine",
                "SpaceComplexity/ConfigCount", "SpaceComplexity/Logspace/InputAccess",
                "SpaceComplexity/Logspace/PreimageHost", "SpaceComplexity/Machines/ARM",
                "SpaceComplexity/Machines/ARMKit", "SpaceComplexity/Machines/ARMProof",
                "SpaceComplexity/Machines/Bank", "SpaceComplexity/Machines/Bin",
                "SpaceComplexity/Machines/CleanSweep", "SpaceComplexity/Machines/Compile",
                "SpaceComplexity/Machines/FragDec", "SpaceComplexity/Machines/Layout",
                "SpaceComplexity/Machines/ParsePlain", "SpaceComplexity/Machines/Program",
                "TuringMachine/Build/Catalog", "TuringMachine/Deterministic",
                "TuringMachine/Encoding", "TuringMachine/Finite"))
        population = sorted(population)
        (evidence / "screen/population-head.txt").write_text("\n".join(population) + "\n")
        (evidence / "screen/population-base.txt").write_text(
            "\n".join(path for path in population if (base / path).exists()) + "\n")
        info = {"base": base_sha, "head": head_sha, "worktree": worktree,
                "base_export": str(base), "head_export": str(head),
                "changed_lean_files": len(changed), "lint_exit_statuses": policy}
        (evidence / "landing/refs.json").write_text(json.dumps(info, indent=2) + "\n")
        summary[gate] = info
        print(gate, "source checks complete", len(changed), "Lean files", flush=True)
    (EXPORTS / "summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2) + "\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Replay msg3 (msg3 current merged tree; branch lean/dedup-sg1, stacked on campaign after NatBits): its downstream closure (329 modules),
# fresh .oleans into oleans-msg3, a copy of oleans-mac2, via scripts/lean_check_tree.sh. The root TCSlib
# module is not listed (replay rule). The precheck pins the changed files' blobs.
S=/Users/seyoonr/phd_experiments/tcslib_all_branches/tcslib-scratch
WT="$S/wt-sg1"
LIST="/Users/seyoonr/phd_experiments/tcslib_all_branches/tcslib-scratch/fills/replay/down-msg3.txt"
LOG="$S/fills/replay/replay-msg3.log"
PINS="TCSlib/Complexity/ClassNP/Tautology.lean:44e3f879ced36807d3b82bd75996ea8ad7ceafed
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/CounterLoop.lean:b2beab0b25899e955adc0117b87abf4fe9fe8f85
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Robustness/SingleTape.lean:560e6cb050ee97872beafd80c417a98eb296f600"
[ -d "$WT/.lake/packages/mathlib/.lake/build/lib/lean/Mathlib" ] || { echo "precheck: $WT/.lake/packages has no Mathlib build; nothing copied" >&2; exit 2; }
git -C "$WT" fetch -q origin 2>/dev/null
[ "$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse origin/lean/dedup-sg1 2>/dev/null)" ] || { echo "precheck: $WT is not at the pushed PR head; nothing copied" >&2; exit 2; }
[ -z "$(git -C "$WT" status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)" ] || { echo "precheck: $WT has local changes; nothing copied" >&2; exit 2; }
git -C "$WT" merge-base --is-ancestor 3555163f40d9c101a2ef4e81407c1bda58fe5ca4 HEAD || { echo "precheck: the head must contain campaign after NatBits; nothing copied" >&2; exit 2; }
[ "$(git -C "$WT" diff --name-only 3555163f40d9c101a2ef4e81407c1bda58fe5ca4 HEAD -- '*.lean' | sort)" = "$(printf '%s\n' "$PINS" | cut -d: -f1 | sort)" ] || { echo "precheck: the Lean diff from campaign after NatBits must be exactly the pinned files; nothing copied" >&2; exit 2; }
while IFS=: read -r f b; do
  [ "$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse "HEAD:$f")" = "$b" ] || { echo "precheck: $f is not the checked blob; nothing copied" >&2; exit 2; }
done <<< "$PINS"
tail -1 "/Users/seyoonr/.codex/worktrees/ab34-records/tcslib-arora-barak-ch3-4/campaign/gates/114-natbits-dedup/evidence/current/campaign-after-epad/replay.log" 2>/dev/null | grep -qx "# modules=[0-9]* failed=0" || { echo "precheck: the previous replay must have passed; nothing copied" >&2; exit 2; }
[ "$(wc -l < "$LIST" | tr -d ' ')" = "329" ] || { echo "precheck: the replay list must have 329 modules; nothing copied" >&2; exit 2; }
grep -qx "TCSlib" "$LIST" && { echo "precheck: the replay list must not contain the root TCSlib; nothing copied" >&2; exit 2; }
[ -d "$S/oleans-msg3" ] && { echo "precheck: $S/oleans-msg3 already exists; remove it for a fresh copy" >&2; exit 2; }
[ -d "$S/oleans-mac2" ] || { echo "precheck: oleans-mac2 is missing; nothing copied" >&2; exit 2; }
echo PRECHECK-PASSED; exit 0

## ===== campaign/gates/106-sg1-dedup/evidence/current-after-natbits/replay-msg3.sh =====

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Replay msg3 (msg3 current merged tree; branch lean/dedup-sg1, stacked on campaign after NatBits): its downstream closure (329 modules),
# fresh .oleans into oleans-msg3, a copy of oleans-mac2, via scripts/lean_check_tree.sh. The root TCSlib
# module is not listed (replay rule). The precheck pins the changed files' blobs.
S=/Users/seyoonr/phd_experiments/tcslib_all_branches/tcslib-scratch
WT="$S/wt-sg1"
LIST="/Users/seyoonr/phd_experiments/tcslib_all_branches/tcslib-scratch/fills/replay/down-msg3.txt"
LOG="$S/fills/replay/replay-msg3.log"
PINS="TCSlib/Complexity/ClassNP/Tautology.lean:44e3f879ced36807d3b82bd75996ea8ad7ceafed
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/CounterLoop.lean:b2beab0b25899e955adc0117b87abf4fe9fe8f85
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Robustness/SingleTape.lean:560e6cb050ee97872beafd80c417a98eb296f600"
[ -d "$WT/.lake/packages/mathlib/.lake/build/lib/lean/Mathlib" ] || { echo "precheck: $WT/.lake/packages has no Mathlib build; nothing copied" >&2; exit 2; }
git -C "$WT" fetch -q origin 2>/dev/null
[ "$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse origin/lean/dedup-sg1 2>/dev/null)" ] || { echo "precheck: $WT is not at the pushed PR head; nothing copied" >&2; exit 2; }
[ -z "$(git -C "$WT" status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)" ] || { echo "precheck: $WT has local changes; nothing copied" >&2; exit 2; }
git -C "$WT" merge-base --is-ancestor 3555163f40d9c101a2ef4e81407c1bda58fe5ca4 HEAD || { echo "precheck: the head must contain campaign after NatBits; nothing copied" >&2; exit 2; }
[ "$(git -C "$WT" diff --name-only 3555163f40d9c101a2ef4e81407c1bda58fe5ca4 HEAD -- '*.lean' | sort)" = "$(printf '%s\n' "$PINS" | cut -d: -f1 | sort)" ] || { echo "precheck: the Lean diff from campaign after NatBits must be exactly the pinned files; nothing copied" >&2; exit 2; }
while IFS=: read -r f b; do
  [ "$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse "HEAD:$f")" = "$b" ] || { echo "precheck: $f is not the checked blob; nothing copied" >&2; exit 2; }
done <<< "$PINS"
tail -1 "/Users/seyoonr/.codex/worktrees/ab34-records/tcslib-arora-barak-ch3-4/campaign/gates/114-natbits-dedup/evidence/current/campaign-after-epad/replay.log" 2>/dev/null | grep -qx "# modules=[0-9]* failed=0" || { echo "precheck: the previous replay must have passed; nothing copied" >&2; exit 2; }

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Replay msg4 (SG-1 cut-proof repair current merged tree; branch lean/dedup-sg1, stacked on campaign after separation consumer): its downstream closure (329 modules),
# fresh .oleans into oleans-msg4, a copy of oleans-mac3, via scripts/lean_check_tree.sh. The root TCSlib
# module is not listed (replay rule). The precheck pins the changed files' blobs.
S=/Users/seyoonr/phd_experiments/tcslib_all_branches/tcslib-scratch
WT="$S/wt-sg1"
LIST="/Users/seyoonr/phd_experiments/tcslib_all_branches/tcslib-scratch/fills/replay/down-msg4.txt"
LOG="$S/fills/replay/replay-msg4.log"
PINS="TCSlib/Complexity/ClassNP/SAT.lean:744ffdd46da65b0d7bda69cd7269cfc934a260b4
TCSlib/Complexity/ClassNP/Tautology.lean:44e3f879ced36807d3b82bd75996ea8ad7ceafed
TCSlib/Complexity/CookLevin/Hardness.lean:70c09f23b3769906f846f6ac4aadc553b819557e
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/CounterLoop.lean:b2beab0b25899e955adc0117b87abf4fe9fe8f85
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Robustness/SingleTape.lean:560e6cb050ee97872beafd80c417a98eb296f600"
[ -d "$WT/.lake/packages/mathlib/.lake/build/lib/lean/Mathlib" ] || { echo "precheck: $WT/.lake/packages has no Mathlib build; nothing copied" >&2; exit 2; }
git -C "$WT" fetch -q origin 2>/dev/null
[ "$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse origin/lean/dedup-sg1 2>/dev/null)" ] || { echo "precheck: $WT is not at the pushed PR head; nothing copied" >&2; exit 2; }
[ -z "$(git -C "$WT" status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)" ] || { echo "precheck: $WT has local changes; nothing copied" >&2; exit 2; }
git -C "$WT" merge-base --is-ancestor e3adffac67377a8b6e23bed74bfdbb44a123dd86 HEAD || { echo "precheck: the head must contain campaign after separation consumer; nothing copied" >&2; exit 2; }
[ "$(git -C "$WT" diff --name-only e3adffac67377a8b6e23bed74bfdbb44a123dd86 HEAD -- '*.lean' | sort)" = "$(printf '%s\n' "$PINS" | cut -d: -f1 | sort)" ] || { echo "precheck: the Lean diff from campaign after separation consumer must be exactly the pinned files; nothing copied" >&2; exit 2; }
while IFS=: read -r f b; do
  [ "$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse "HEAD:$f")" = "$b" ] || { echo "precheck: $f is not the checked blob; nothing copied" >&2; exit 2; }
done <<< "$PINS"
tail -1 "/Users/seyoonr/phd_experiments/tcslib_all_branches/tcslib-scratch/fills/replay/replay-mlin2.log" 2>/dev/null | grep -qx "# modules=[0-9]* failed=0" || { echo "precheck: the previous replay must have passed; nothing copied" >&2; exit 2; }
[ "$(wc -l < "$LIST" | tr -d ' ')" = "329" ] || { echo "precheck: the replay list must have 329 modules; nothing copied" >&2; exit 2; }
grep -qx "TCSlib" "$LIST" && { echo "precheck: the replay list must not contain the root TCSlib; nothing copied" >&2; exit 2; }
[ -d "$S/oleans-msg4" ] && { echo "precheck: $S/oleans-msg4 already exists; remove it for a fresh copy" >&2; exit 2; }
[ -d "$S/oleans-mac3" ] || { echo "precheck: oleans-mac3 is missing; nothing copied" >&2; exit 2; }
echo PRECHECK-PASSED; exit 0

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Replay msg4 (SG-1 cut-proof repair current merged tree; branch lean/dedup-sg1, stacked on campaign after separation consumer): its downstream closure (329 modules),
# fresh .oleans into oleans-msg4, a copy of oleans-mac3, via scripts/lean_check_tree.sh. The root TCSlib
# module is not listed (replay rule). The precheck pins the changed files' blobs.
S=/Users/seyoonr/phd_experiments/tcslib_all_branches/tcslib-scratch
WT="$S/wt-sg1"
LIST="/Users/seyoonr/phd_experiments/tcslib_all_branches/tcslib-scratch/fills/replay/down-msg4.txt"
LOG="$S/fills/replay/replay-msg4.log"
PINS="TCSlib/Complexity/ClassNP/SAT.lean:744ffdd46da65b0d7bda69cd7269cfc934a260b4
TCSlib/Complexity/ClassNP/Tautology.lean:44e3f879ced36807d3b82bd75996ea8ad7ceafed
TCSlib/Complexity/CookLevin/Hardness.lean:70c09f23b3769906f846f6ac4aadc553b819557e
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/CounterLoop.lean:b2beab0b25899e955adc0117b87abf4fe9fe8f85
TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Robustness/SingleTape.lean:560e6cb050ee97872beafd80c417a98eb296f600"
[ -d "$WT/.lake/packages/mathlib/.lake/build/lib/lean/Mathlib" ] || { echo "precheck: $WT/.lake/packages has no Mathlib build; nothing copied" >&2; exit 2; }
git -C "$WT" fetch -q origin 2>/dev/null
[ "$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse origin/lean/dedup-sg1 2>/dev/null)" ] || { echo "precheck: $WT is not at the pushed PR head; nothing copied" >&2; exit 2; }
[ -z "$(git -C "$WT" status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)" ] || { echo "precheck: $WT has local changes; nothing copied" >&2; exit 2; }
git -C "$WT" merge-base --is-ancestor e3adffac67377a8b6e23bed74bfdbb44a123dd86 HEAD || { echo "precheck: the head must contain campaign after separation consumer; nothing copied" >&2; exit 2; }
[ "$(git -C "$WT" diff --name-only e3adffac67377a8b6e23bed74bfdbb44a123dd86 HEAD -- '*.lean' | sort)" = "$(printf '%s\n' "$PINS" | cut -d: -f1 | sort)" ] || { echo "precheck: the Lean diff from campaign after separation consumer must be exactly the pinned files; nothing copied" >&2; exit 2; }
while IFS=: read -r f b; do
  [ "$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse "HEAD:$f")" = "$b" ] || { echo "precheck: $f is not the checked blob; nothing copied" >&2; exit 2; }
done <<< "$PINS"
tail -1 "/Users/seyoonr/phd_experiments/tcslib_all_branches/tcslib-scratch/fills/replay/replay-mlin2.log" 2>/dev/null | grep -qx "# modules=[0-9]* failed=0" || { echo "precheck: the previous replay must have passed; nothing copied" >&2; exit 2; }
[ "$(wc -l < "$LIST" | tr -d ' ')" = "329" ] || { echo "precheck: the replay list must have 329 modules; nothing copied" >&2; exit 2; }
grep -qx "TCSlib" "$LIST" && { echo "precheck: the replay list must not contain the root TCSlib; nothing copied" >&2; exit 2; }
[ -d "$S/oleans-msg4" ] && { echo "precheck: $S/oleans-msg4 already exists; remove it for a fresh copy" >&2; exit 2; }
[ -d "$S/oleans-mac3" ] || { echo "precheck: oleans-mac3 is missing; nothing copied" >&2; exit 2; }
cp -R "$S/oleans-mac3" "$S/oleans-msg4" || exit 1
cd "$WT" || exit 1
{ echo "# replay-msg4 at $(git rev-parse --short HEAD): SG-1 cut-proof repair current merged tree ($(wc -l < "$LIST" | tr -d ' ') modules), fresh .oleans into oleans-msg4"
  n=0; f=0
  while read -r m; do
    n=$((n+1))
    out=$(TCSLIB_OLEANS=$S/oleans-msg4 nice -n 10 bash scripts/lean_check_tree.sh "$m" 2>&1); st=$?
    e=$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -c "error")
    echo "$m exit=$st errors=$e sorry=$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -c "declaration uses 'sorry'")"
    [ $st -ne 0 ] && { f=$((f+1)); printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep error | head -3 | sed "s#$PWD/##g"; }
  done < "$LIST"
  echo "# modules=$n failed=$f"
} > "$LOG" 2>&1
python3 -I "$S/api/staticsorry.py" "$WT" "$LOG" > "${LOG%.log}-static.txt"; sst=$?
tail -n 6 "$LOG"
tail -n 1 "${LOG%.log}-static.txt"
# the exit status: nonzero unless every listed module passed and the static check found no mismatch
tail -1 "$LOG" | grep -qx "# modules=329 failed=0" || { echo "replay: a module failed, or the count is not 329" >&2; exit 1; }
[ $sst -eq 0 ] && tail -1 "${LOG%.log}-static.txt" | grep -q "mismatches 0," || { echo "replay: the static sorry check failed" >&2; exit 1; }
exit 0

example {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (F : Set (Option S)) (P : (Fin k → ℤ) → Prop)
    (a b : Cfg k Bool S x) (t : ℕ) :
    Segment M F P a b t ↔ M.runFrom a t = b ∧
      (∀ u < t, (M.runFrom a u).state ∉ F) ∧
      (∀ u ≤ t, P (M.runFrom a u).workTapePos) := by rfl

example {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (F : Set (Option S)) (P : (Fin k → ℤ) → Prop) :
    (Segment M F P : Cfg k Bool S x → Cfg k Bool S x → ℕ → Prop) =
      (fun a b t => M.runFrom a t = b ∧
        (∀ u < t, (M.runFrom a u).state ∉ F) ∧
        (∀ u ≤ t, P (M.runFrom a u).workTapePos)) := by rfl

example {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (c : Cfg k Bool S x) (t : ℕ) :
    M.runFrom c t = M.step^[t] c := by rfl

example {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) :
    (M.runFrom : Cfg k Bool S x → ℕ → Cfg k Bool S x) =
      (fun c t => M.step^[t] c) := by rfl
