```
"""Read immutable audit/pack evidence as data. No Git, Lean, or screen execution."""
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import sys

sys.dont_write_bytecode=True
OUT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
REPO=OUT.parents[4]
GATE=REPO/'campaign/gates/106-sg1-dedup'


def sections():
    d=json.loads((GATE/'dispatch.json').read_text())
    p=Path(os.environ['TCSLIB_EXCHANGE'])/'outbox/gates/106-sg1-dedup-gate/106-sg1-dedup-bundle.md'
    raw=p.read_bytes();assert len(raw)==d['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==d['sha256']
    s=raw.decode();matches=list(re.finditer(r'^## ===== (.+) =====\n',s,re.M))
    names=[m[1] for m in matches]
    assert len(names)==len(set(names))==d['sections']==166
    index=(p.parent/'BUNDLE-FILES.txt').read_text().splitlines()
    assert names==index
    data={}
    for i,m in enumerate(matches):
        block=s[m.end():matches[i+1].start() if i+1<len(matches) else len(s)].strip('\n')
        if block.startswith('```\n') and block.endswith('\n```'):block=block[4:-4]
        data[m[1]]=block+'\n'
    return d,data


def main():
    audit=(OUT/'findings.received.md').read_bytes()
    assert len(audit)==9822 and hashlib.sha256(audit).hexdigest()=='f6263c500ec7496a8867b7652bd44a1dbc423bd2711d5c6268a40347332b058c'
    dispatch,sec=sections()
    tool=REPO/'campaign/fills/mig1/review/checkpoint05-2026-11-07/compare.py'
    spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('independent_decl_reader',tool)
    mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
    population=(GATE/'evidence/current/screen/population-head.txt').read_text().splitlines()
    sources={f:sec[f] for f in population}
    all_decl={f:mod.decls(s) for f,s in sources.items()}
    scopes={f:{d['name']:d for d in ds} for f,ds in all_decl.items()}
    sat='TCSlib/Complexity/ClassNP/SAT.lean';hard='TCSlib/Complexity/CookLevin/Hardness.lean'
    basic='TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Contract/Basic.lean'
    wanted={sat:['sat_guard_add','SatClean','satStopTM','satPadCfg','satMapTM','satPadAction','satStopCfg','sat_bridge_bound'],
            hard:['clA5_guard_add','CLA5Clean','clA5StopTM','clA5PadCfg','clA5MapTM','clA5PadAction','clA5StopCfg','clA5_bridge_bound'],
            basic:['Segment.trans','Segment.zero','Segment.mono','segment_iff','Segment'],
            'TCSlib/Complexity/ClassNP/Tautology.lean':['tautDualSegment','tautDualSegment_iff_segment'],
            'TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/CounterLoop.lean':['counterSpan','counterSpan_iff_segment'],
            'TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Robustness/SingleTape.lean':['DGSpan','dgSpan_iff_segment']}
    quotes=[];details={}
    for f,names in wanted.items():
        details[f]=[]
        lines=sources[f].splitlines()
        for n in names:
            matches=[d for d in all_decl[f] if d['name']==n or d['name'].endswith('.'+n)]
            assert len(matches)==1,(f,n,[d['name'] for d in matches])
            d=matches[0]
            last=d['start']-1+max(i+1 for i,l in enumerate(d['code'].splitlines()) if l.strip())
            # Include an adjacent docstring when present; record code and total span separately.
            before='\n'.join(lines[:d['start']-1]).rstrip()
            start=d['start']
            if before.endswith('-/'):
                j=before.rfind('/--')
                if j>=0 and before.find('-/',j)==len(before)-2:start=before.count('\n',0,j)+1
            details[f].append(dict(name=d['name'],kind=d['kind'],private=d['private'],
                                   declaration_line=d['start'],span_start=start,span_end=last,
                                   span_lines=last-start+1,header=d['header'],code=d['code'].rstrip()))
            quotes.append(f'## {f}:{start}–{last}\n\n```lean\n'+'\n'.join(f'{i+1}: {lines[i]}' for i in range(start-1,last))+'\n```\n')
    (OUT/'source-quotes.md').write_text('\n'.join(quotes))
    replay=json.loads((GATE/'evidence/current-after-natbits/receipt.json').read_text())
    blobchecks=[]
    for row in replay['audited_scope']:
        b=sources[row['path']].encode()
        blob=hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(b)).encode()+b'\0'+b).hexdigest()
        assert blob==row['audited_blob']==row['current_blob']
        assert hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==row['source_sha256']
        blobchecks.append(dict(path=row['path'],git_blob_sha1=blob,sha256=row['source_sha256']))
    artifacts=[]
    for a in replay['artifacts']:
        p=GATE/'evidence/current-after-natbits'/a['path'];b=p.read_bytes()
        assert len(b)==a['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==a['sha256']
        artifacts.append(a['path'])
    log=(GATE/'evidence/current-after-natbits/replay-msg3.log').read_text()
    rows=[l for l in log.splitlines() if re.match(r'TCSlib/.* exit=',l)]
    assert len(rows)==329 and all('exit=0 errors=0' in l for l in rows)
    assert log.rstrip().endswith('# modules=329 failed=0')
    assert (GATE/'evidence/current-after-natbits/replay-msg3-static.txt').read_text().strip()=='modules 329, mismatches 0, static total 67'
    out=dict(dispatch=dispatch,bundle_sections=166,audit_sha256=hashlib.sha256(audit).hexdigest(),
             source_counts={f:len(ds) for f,ds in all_decl.items()},source_details=details,
             audited_current_blob_checks=blobchecks,
             msg3=dict(modules=329,failed=0,static_mismatches=0,static_admissions=67,
                       all_receipt_artifact_hashes_match=True,artifacts=artifacts),
             limitation='Hashes and supplied evidence parsed independently; no Git object read, replay, Lean, seal, screen, or payload script execution.')
    (OUT/'crosschecks.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n')
    print('source counts',out['source_counts'])
    print('audit/bundle integrity PASS; four audited/current source blobs match; msg3 artifact hashes and329 recorded exits/static67 match')
    for f in [sat,hard]:print(f,[(d['name'],d['span_lines']) for d in details[f]])


if __name__=='__main__':main()
```

        "header": "private lemma sat_bridge_bound (c A d n len : \u2115) (hlen : len \u2264 A * (n + 1) ^ d) : c * (A * (n + 1) ^ d + n + len + 1) + 1 \u2264 (c * (2 * A + 1) + 1) * (n + 1) ^ (d + 1)",
        "code": "private lemma sat_bridge_bound (c A d n len : \u2115) (hlen : len \u2264 A * (n + 1) ^ d) :\n    c * (A * (n + 1) ^ d + n + len + 1) + 1 \u2264\n      (c * (2 * A + 1) + 1) * (n + 1) ^ (d + 1) := by\n  have hd := Nat.mul_le_mul_left A\n    (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.succ_pos n) (show d \u2264 d + 1 by omega))\n  simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one] at hd\n  have hn : n + 1 \u2264 (n + 1) ^ (d + 1) := by\n    simpa using Nat.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.succ_pos n) (show 1 \u2264 d + 1 by omega)\n  have h1 : 1 \u2264 (n + 1) ^ (d + 1) := by omega\n  calc\n    _ \u2264 c * ((2 * A + 1) * (n + 1) ^ (d + 1)) + 1 := by\n      apply Nat.add_le_add_right\n      apply Nat.mul_le_mul_left\n      simp only [Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul, Nat.mul_assoc, two_mul]\n      omega\n    _ \u2264 c * ((2 * A + 1) * (n + 1) ^ (d + 1)) + (n + 1) ^ (d + 1) := Nat.add_le_add_left h1 _\n    _ = _ := by ring"
      }

        "header": "private lemma clA5_guard_add {k : \u2115} {S : Type} {x : List Bool} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (anchor : S) (c d : Cfg k Bool S x) (a b : \u2115) (ha : \u2200 v < a, (tm.runFrom c v).state \u2260 some anchor) (he : tm.runFrom c a = d) (hb : \u2200 v < b, (tm.runFrom d v).state \u2260 some anchor) : \u2200 v < a + b, (tm.runFrom c v).state \u2260 some anchor",
        "code": "private lemma clA5_guard_add {k : \u2115} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}\n    (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (anchor : S) (c d : Cfg k Bool S x) (a b : \u2115)\n    (ha : \u2200 v < a, (tm.runFrom c v).state \u2260 some anchor)\n    (he : tm.runFrom c a = d)\n    (hb : \u2200 v < b, (tm.runFrom d v).state \u2260 some anchor) :\n    \u2200 v < a + b, (tm.runFrom c v).state \u2260 some anchor := by\n  intro v hv\n  by_cases h : v < a\n  \u00b7 exact ha v h\n  \u00b7 have hva : a \u2264 v := by omega\n    rw [\u2190 Nat.add_sub_of_le hva, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, he]\n    exact hb (v - a) (by omega)"

        "header": "theorem trans {a b c : Cfg k \u0393 S x} {t v : \u2115} (h : Segment M F P a b t) (g : Segment M F P b c v) : Segment M F P a c (t + v)",
        "code": "theorem trans {a b c : Cfg k \u0393 S x} {t v : \u2115} (h : Segment M F P a b t)\n    (g : Segment M F P b c v) : Segment M F P a c (t + v) := by\n  refine \u27e8by rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, h.1, g.1], ?_, ?_\u27e9\n  \u00b7 intro u hu\n    by_cases hut : u < t\n    \u00b7 exact h.2.1 u hut\n    \u00b7 have he : u = t + (u - t) := by omega\n      rw [he, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, h.1]\n      exact g.2.1 _ (by omega)\n  \u00b7 intro u hu\n    by_cases hut : u \u2264 t\n    \u00b7 exact h.2.2 u hut\n    \u00b7 have he : u = t + (u - t) := by omega\n      rw [he, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, h.1]\n      exact g.2.2 _ (by omega)"

        "code": "theorem mono {F' : Set (Option S)} {P' : (Fin k \u2192 \u2124) \u2192 Prop} {a b : Cfg k \u0393 S x} {t : \u2115}\n    (h : Segment M F P a b t) (hF : F' \u2286 F) (hP : \u2200 p, P p \u2192 P' p) : Segment M F' P' a b t :=\n  \u27e8h.1, fun u hu hm => h.2.1 u hu (hF hm), fun u hu => hP _ (h.2.2 u hu)\u27e9"

        "code": "private def counterSpan {k : \u2115} {\u0393 S : Type} {x : List \u0393}\n    (H : MultiTapeTM (k + 1) \u0393 (CounterLoopState S))\n    (z : Cfg (k + 1) \u0393 (CounterLoopState S) x) (t : \u2115) (cp : \u2124) (width : \u2115)\n    (R : (Fin k \u2192 \u2124) \u2192 Prop) : Prop :=\n  (\u2200 u < t, (H.runFrom z u).state \u2260 some .done \u2227\n    (H.runFrom z u).state \u2260 some .escape) \u2227\n  (\u2200 u \u2264 t, (H.runFrom z u).workTapePos (Fin.last k) \u2208\n    Finset.Icc (cp - 1) (cp + (width : \u2124))) \u2227\n  (\u2200 u \u2264 t, R (fun j => (H.runFrom z u).workTapePos j.castSucc))"
      },
      {
        "name": "Turing.counterSpan_iff_segment",
        "kind": "lemma",
        "private": true,

        "header": "private lemma counterSpan_iff_segment {k : \u2115} {\u0393 S : Type} {x : List \u0393} (H : MultiTapeTM (k + 1) \u0393 (CounterLoopState S)) (z : Cfg (k + 1) \u0393 (CounterLoopState S) x) (t : \u2115) (cp : \u2124) (width : \u2115) (R : (Fin k \u2192 \u2124) \u2192 Prop) : counterSpan H z t cp width R \u2194 Segment H {some .done, some .escape} (fun p => p (Fin.last k) \u2208 Finset.Icc (cp - 1) (cp + (width : \u2124)) \u2227 R fun j => p j.castSucc) z (H.runFrom z t) t",
        "code": "private lemma counterSpan_iff_segment {k : \u2115} {\u0393 S : Type} {x : List \u0393}\n    (H : MultiTapeTM (k + 1) \u0393 (CounterLoopState S))\n    (z : Cfg (k + 1) \u0393 (CounterLoopState S) x) (t : \u2115) (cp : \u2124) (width : \u2115)\n    (R : (Fin k \u2192 \u2124) \u2192 Prop) :\n    counterSpan H z t cp width R \u2194\n      Segment H {some .done, some .escape}\n        (fun p => p (Fin.last k) \u2208 Finset.Icc (cp - 1) (cp + (width : \u2124)) \u2227\n          R fun j => p j.castSucc)\n        z (H.runFrom z t) t := by\n  rw [Turing.segment_iff]\n  exact \u27e8fun \u27e8hc, hh, hr\u27e9 => \u27e8rfl, fun u hu hm => Or.elim hm (hc u hu).1 (hc u hu).2,\n      fun u hu => \u27e8hh u hu, hr u hu\u27e9\u27e9,\n    fun \u27e8_, hc, hp\u27e9 =>\n      \u27e8fun u hu => \u27e8fun h => hc u hu (Or.inl h), fun h => hc u hu (Or.inr h)\u27e9,\n        fun u hu => (hp u hu).1, fun u hu => (hp u hu).2\u27e9\u27e9"

        "header": "private def DGSpan {A Q : Type} {x : List A} (tm : MultiTapeTM 1 A Q) (c d : Cfg 1 A Q x) (t : \u2115) (lo hi : \u2124) : Prop",
        "code": "private def DGSpan {A Q : Type} {x : List A} (tm : MultiTapeTM 1 A Q)\n    (c d : Cfg 1 A Q x) (t : \u2115) (lo hi : \u2124) : Prop :=\n  tm.runFrom c t = d \u2227 \u2200 u \u2264 t,\n    lo \u2264 (tm.runFrom c u).workTapePos 0 \u2227 (tm.runFrom c u).workTapePos 0 \u2264 hi"

        "code": "private lemma dgSpan_iff_segment {A Q : Type} {x : List A} (tm : MultiTapeTM 1 A Q)\n    (c d : Cfg 1 A Q x) (t : \u2115) (lo hi : \u2124) :\n    DGSpan tm c d t lo hi \u2194 Segment tm \u2205 (fun p => lo \u2264 p 0 \u2227 p 0 \u2264 hi) c d t := by\n  rw [Turing.segment_iff]\n  exact \u27e8fun h => \u27e8h.1, fun _ _ hm => hm, h.2\u27e9, fun h => \u27e8h.1, h.2.2\u27e9\u27e9"

```
"""Bounded named correspondence checks, not a rerun of the copy-text screen."""
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import sys

sys.dont_write_bytecode=True
OUT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('reader',OUT/'crosscheck.py')
r=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(r)
_,sec=r.sections();REPO=r.REPO
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('decls',REPO/'campaign/fills/mig1/review/checkpoint05-2026-11-07/compare.py')
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m)
SAT='TCSlib/Complexity/ClassNP/SAT.lean';HARD='TCSlib/Complexity/CookLevin/Hardness.lean'


def ren(t):return re.sub(r'\bSat','CLA5',re.sub(r'\bsat','clA5',t))
def arity(t):return re.sub(r'\bFin 6\b','Fin 5',ren(t))
def span(text,d):
    lines=text.splitlines();end=d['start']-1+max(i+1 for i,l in enumerate(d['code'].splitlines()) if l.strip())
    before='\n'.join(lines[:d['start']-1]).rstrip();start=d['start']
    if before.endswith('-/'):
        j=before.rfind('/--')
        if j>=0 and before.find('-/',j)==len(before)-2:start=before.count('\n',0,j)+1
    return dict(start=start,end=end,lines=end-start+1)


def main():
    sources={SAT:sec[SAT],HARD:sec[HARD]}
    a={d['name'].split('.')[-1]:d for d in m.decls(sources[SAT])};b={d['name'].split('.')[-1]:d for d in m.decls(sources[HARD])}
    groups={
        'uniform_clean_module_contract_and_bridges':['SatClean','satClean_install','satClean_emit','satClean_stop'],
        'bank_padding_action_cfg_machine_and_frame_run':['satPadAction','satPadCfg','satPadTM','satPad_apply','satPad_run','satPad_seam'],
        'positive_release_stop_adapter_and_correctness':['satStopTM','satStopCfg','satStop_step','satStop_clean'],
        'finite_word_transducer_cfg_run_poly_and_projections':['satMapTM','satMapWord','satMapCfg','satMap_run','satMap_poly','sat_pt_head','sat_pt_tail'],
        'polynomial_bridge_overhead_bound':['sat_bridge_bound']}
    rows=[];quotes=[]
    for group,names in groups.items():
        for n in names:
            other=n.replace('Sat','CLA5',1) if n.startswith('Sat') else n.replace('sat','clA5',1)
            x,y=a[n],b[other]
            assert m.norm(ren(x['header']))==m.norm(y['header'])
            assert m.norm(ren(x['code']))==m.norm(y['code'])
            rows.append(dict(kind=group,sat=n,hardness=other,header_and_code_equal_after_prefix_map=True,
                             sat_span=span(sources[SAT],x),hardness_span=span(sources[HARD],y)))
    assert len(rows)==22
    host=[]
    for n in ['SatHostState','satHostEntry','satHostRet','satHostTM','satHost_seam','satHost_call','satHost_clean']:
        other=n.replace('Sat','CLA5',1) if n.startswith('Sat') else n.replace('sat','clA5',1)
        x,y=a[n],b[other]
        code=arity(x['code'])
        target_index_change=n=='satHostTM'
        if target_index_change:code=code.replace('clA5HostEntry M 2','clA5HostEntry M 3')
        assert m.norm(code)==m.norm(y['code']),n
        host.append(dict(sat=n,hardness=other,kind=x['kind'],
                         code_equal_after_prefix_and_arity_substitution=True,
                         anchor_dispatch_target_parameter_changes_2_to_3=target_index_change,
                         sat_span=span(sources[SAT],x),hardness_span=span(sources[HARD],y)))
        for f,d in [(SAT,x),(HARD,y)]:
            sp=span(sources[f],d);ls=sources[f].splitlines()
            quotes.append(f'## {f}:{sp["start"]}–{sp["end"]}\n\n```lean\n'+'\n'.join(f'{i+1}: {ls[i]}' for i in range(sp['start']-1,sp['end']))+'\n```\n')
    # Current working-copy validation is source-only, anchored to all four msg3 scope hashes.
    wt=Path(os.environ['TCSLIB_SCRATCH'])/'wt-sg1'
    receipt=json.loads((r.GATE/'evidence/current-after-natbits/receipt.json').read_text())
    for row in receipt['audited_scope']:assert hashlib.sha256((wt/row['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==row['source_sha256']
    current={f:(wt/f).read_text() for f in [SAT,HARD]}
    for row in rows+host:
        for f,key,old in [(SAT,'sat',a),(HARD,'hardness',b)]:
            ds={d['name'].split('.')[-1]:d for d in m.decls(current[f])}
            assert m.norm(ds[row[key]]['code'])==m.norm(old[row[key]]['code'])
    old_debt={SAT:['sat_first_halt','sat_call_first_halt','sat_pt_eq','satRed_one','sat_live_prefix'],
              HARD:['clA5_call_first_halt','clA5_pt_eq','clA5_live_prefix']}
    current_counts={f:len(m.decls(t)) for f,t in current.items()}
    counts={}
    for f,key in [(SAT,'sat'),(HARD,'hardness')]:
        n=[z[key] for z in rows]+[z[key] for z in host]+old_debt[f]
        assert len(set(n))==len(n)
        ds={d['name'].split('.')[-1]:d for d in m.decls(current[f])}
        assert all(n in ds for n in old_debt[f])
        counts[f]=dict(current_declarations=current_counts[f],current_source_sha256=hashlib.sha256(current[f].encode()).hexdigest(),
                       exact_five_kind_members=22,additional_host_non_abbrev_members=6,additional_host_abbrev_members=1,
                       other_named_active_members=old_debt[f],known_union_with_host_alias_excluding_F1=len(n),
                       known_union_with_host_alias_including_F1=len(n)+1,
                       note='Known named union/lower bound; wider RO1 and remaining semantic candidates are not asserted closed. Host alias shown explicitly; do not conflate rule10 abbrev transparency with a blanket census exemption.')
    # Family-only classification of every supplied directed SAT/Hardness screen candidate.
    candidates=json.loads((OUT/'sat-hardness-directed-candidates.json').read_text())
    exact_names={z['sat'] for z in rows}|{z['hardness'] for z in rows}
    host_names={z['sat'] for z in host}|{z['hardness'] for z in host}
    for row in candidates:
        ns={row['target'].split('::')[1],row['source'].split('::')[1]}
        if ns=={'sat_guard_add','clA5_guard_add'}:label='F1 cut-only composition; confirmed, outside old SG1'
        elif ns<={'sat_call_first_halt','clA5_call_first_halt'}:label='existing FH1'
        elif ns<={'sat_live_prefix','clA5_live_prefix'}:label='existing live-prefix watch/item11 T2'
        elif ns<={'sat_pt_eq','clA5_pt_eq'}:label='existing PL1/WT1'
        elif ns<=exact_names:label='F2 five exact generic kinds; repeated edges count each declaration once'
        elif ns<=host_names:label='additional finite-family shared-bank dispatcher kind; independent ruling needed'
        elif 'satRed_one' in ns:label='RO1 versus machine-step specializations; wider RO1 classification remains pending'
        elif any(n.startswith(('sat_pt_','clNative_','clLastCode_','clA5Fuel')) for n in ns):label='polynomial closure/field-reading candidates; existing PL1 and QF1 do not give blanket cross-file acceptance'
        elif any(n.startswith(('satScan','clA5Map')) for n in ns):label='generic transducer versus fixed scanner scaffold; not asserted same machine/contract'
        else:label='step/run-agreement scaffold with different statements; semantic candidate, not automatically debt or exempt'
        row['family_classification']=label
    out=dict(five_kinds=groups,exact_correspondences=rows,
             exact_correspondence_span_totals={key:sum(z[key]['lines'] for z in rows) for key in ['sat_span','hardness_span']},
             host_kind=host,host_client_routing_tables_excluded=['satHostNext','clA5HostNext'],
             prior_scopes=dict(SG1='private Segment predicates and their concatenation, explicitly excludes cut-only',
                               DR2='Primitives/Catalog/Loop family inventory, not SAT/Hardness adapters',
                               FH1='first-halting-time construction, not arbitrary stop/clean adapter proofs',
                               PL1_WT1='fixed-word test linear/poly lift and sat_pt_eq/clA5_pt_eq, not head/tail projections',
                               QF1='in-file row/field conversions, not blanket cross-file generic-machine acceptance',
                               MIG21_item13='clPlacement selector/certified-layout layer, not dispatcher/module host',
                               BL1='retired by NatBits in current tree; Hardness denominator545 to544'),
             cumulative_known_union=counts,directed_candidates_classified=candidates,
             limitation='Named static correspondence checks and supplied candidate classification only. No new copy-text screen, Lean, Git, or code change. Semantic candidate labels are not debt acknowledgment.')
    (OUT/'family-accounting.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n')
    (OUT/'host-source-quotes.md').write_text('\n'.join(quotes))
    print('exact generic pairs22; span totals',out['exact_correspondence_span_totals'])
    print('dispatcher pairs7 =6 non-abbrevs +1 transparent type alias; all verified under explicit parameter map')
    print('known union',counts)


if __name__=='__main__':main()
```

```
    assert len(sat_hard)==86
    out['sat_hardness_candidates']=dict(directed=len(sat_hard),sat_endpoints=len({x.split('::')[1] for r in sat_hard for x in [r['target'],r['source']] if x.startswith('SAT.lean::')}),hardness_endpoints=len({x.split('::')[1] for r in sat_hard for x in [r['target'],r['source']] if x.startswith('Hardness.lean::')}))
    (OUT/'sat-hardness-directed-candidates.json').write_text(json.dumps(sat_hard,indent=2)+'\n')
    for label in ['base','head']:
        raw=(GATE/'evidence/current/axioms'/('ModuleCensus-'+label+'.out')).read_text()
        rows=[l for l in raw.splitlines() if l.startswith('CONSTANT ')]
        assert len(rows)==293
        out['compiled_'+label]=rows
    assert out['compiled_base']==out['compiled_head']
    out['compiled_census']=dict(base=293,head=293,all_name_owner_kind_internal_rows_equal=True)
    del out['compiled_base'];del out['compiled_head']
    ax=(GATE/'evidence/current/axioms/Axioms.out').read_text()
    entries=re.findall(r"^'([^']+)' depends on axioms: \[([^\]]*)\]$",ax,re.M)
    assert len(entries)==6 and all(set(v.split(', '))=={'propext','Classical.choice','Quot.sound'} for n,v in entries)
    assert {n for n,v in entries}=={d['name'] for r in changes.values() for d in r['public_proof_changes']}
    out['axioms']=dict(names=[n for n,v in entries],all_six_changed_public_proofs_covered=True,only_standard_axioms_in_supplied_output=True)
    # Check availability in the audited consumer tree, using pinned source overrides.
    target='TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Contract/Basic.lean';paths={}
    for start in ['TCSlib/Complexity/ClassNP/SAT.lean','TCSlib/Complexity/CookLevin/Hardness.lean']:
        q=deque([[start]]);seen=set()
        while q:
            path=q.popleft();f=path[-1]
            if f==target:paths[start]=path;break
            if f in seen:continue
            seen.add(f);p=REPO/f
            s=sec[f] if f in sec else p.read_text() if p.exists() else ''
            for l in s.splitlines():
                if l.startswith('import TCSlib.'):q.append(path+[l.split()[1].replace('.','/')+'.lean'])
        assert start in paths
    out['Segment_availability_paths']=paths
    out['limitation']='Static source and supplied-log checks only. No compiler, screen, Git, or delivered tool executed. Import paths use pinned9-file overrides and unchanged local dependency import headers.'
    (OUT/'additional-crosschecks.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n')
    print('calls',calls)
    print('public changed',[(f,[d['name'] for d in r['public_proof_changes']]) for f,r in changes.items()])
    print('sealed probes contain source unchanged; screen data agree;293 census rows equal;6 axiom names agree')
    print('SAT/Hardness candidate endpoint counts',out['sat_hardness_candidates'])


if __name__=='__main__':main()
```

## TCSlib/Complexity/ClassNP/SAT.lean:4000–4011

```lean
4000: /-- The actual finite controller. All modules use the same padded work bank,
4001: so the clean-call contracts restore scratch before each next call. `emitAction`
4002: forwards the halting transition as well as ordinary transitions. -/
4003: private def satHostTM (M : Fin 6 → FinTM Bool) (K : ℕ) (hk : ∀ i, (M i).k ≤ K) : FinTM Bool where
4004:   k := K
4005:   State := SatHostState M
4006:   tm := {
4007:     q₀ := satHostEntry M 0
4008:     tr := fun q inp work => match q with
4009:       | .inl _ => FinTM.controlAction 0 (some (satHostEntry M 2))
4010:       | .inr ⟨i, s⟩ => emitAction (fun s => .inr ⟨i, s⟩) (satHostRet M i)
4011:           ((satPadTM (M i) K (hk i)).tm.tr s inp work) }
```

```lean
4013: /-- Forwarding a padded clean configuration produces the host's canonical
4014: seam with precisely the supplied output prefix. Positive tape count is used
4015: only to identify the real tape-zero word. -/
4016: private lemma satHost_seam (M : Fin 6 → FinTM Bool) (K : ℕ) (i : Fin 6)
4017:     (hp : 0 < (M i).k) (x w pre out : List Bool) (q : (M i).State)
4018:     (state : Option (M i).State) :
4019:     emitCfg (fun s => (Sum.inr ⟨i, s⟩ : SatHostState M)) (satHostRet M i) pre
4020:       (satPadCfg (K := K) {Cfg.ofWords (input := x) q (stateWord (M i).k w)
4021:         with state := state, output := out}) =
4022:       {Cfg.ofWords (((state.map (fun s => (Sum.inr ⟨i, s⟩ : SatHostState M))).getD (satHostRet M i)))
4023:         (stateWord K w) with output := pre ++ out} := by
4024:   have h := satPad_seam (K := K) (x := x) hp q w out
4025:   refine Cfg.ext rfl rfl ?_ ?_ rfl
4026:   · exact congrArg (fun c : Cfg K Bool (M i).State x => c.workTapes) h
4027:   · exact congrArg (fun c : Cfg K Bool (M i).State x => c.workTapePos) h
```

## TCSlib/Complexity/ClassNP/SAT.lean:4029–4072

```lean
4029: /-- Run one clean module inside the body, forwarding exactly its output.
4030: **Proof sketch.** Padding preserves the source run. The audited `emit_run`
4031: then transfers every live prefix and the halting endpoint; live prefixes
4032: always remain in that module's state summand, hence cannot hit the anchor. -/
4033: private lemma satHost_call (M : Fin 6 → FinTM Bool) (K : ℕ) (hk : ∀ i, (M i).k ≤ K)
4034:     (i : Fin 6) (hp : 0 < (M i).k) (x arg result out pre : List Bool)
4035:     (q : (M i).State) (t : ℕ)
4036:     (hg : ∀ v < t, ¬((M i).tm.runFrom
4037:       (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (M i).tm.q₀ (stateWord (M i).k arg)) v).Halted)
4038:     (he : (M i).tm.runFrom
4039:       (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (M i).tm.q₀ (stateWord (M i).k arg)) t =
4040:       {Cfg.ofWords q (stateWord (M i).k result) with state := none, output := out}) :
4041:     (∀ v < t, ((satHostTM M K hk).tm.runFrom
4042:       {Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (satHostEntry M i) (stateWord K arg) with output := pre} v).state
4043:         ≠ some (.inl ())) ∧
4044:     (satHostTM M K hk).tm.runFrom
4045:       {Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (satHostEntry M i) (stateWord K arg) with output := pre} t =
4046:       {Cfg.ofWords (satHostRet M i) (stateWord K result) with output := pre ++ out} := by
4047:   let c := Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (M i).tm.q₀ (stateWord (M i).k arg)
4048:   let emb : (M i).State → SatHostState M := fun s => .inr ⟨i, s⟩
4049:   have hinit : emitCfg emb (satHostRet M i) pre (satPadCfg (K := K) c) =
4050:       {Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (satHostEntry M i) (stateWord K arg) with output := pre} := by
4051:     simpa [emb, c, satHostEntry] using
4052:       satHost_seam M K i hp x arg pre [] (M i).tm.q₀ (some (M i).tm.q₀)
4053:   have hrun (v : ℕ) (hv : v ≤ t) :
4054:       (satHostTM M K hk).tm.runFrom
4055:         {Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (satHostEntry M i) (stateWord K arg) with output := pre} v =
4056:         emitCfg emb (satHostRet M i) pre (satPadCfg ((M i).tm.runFrom c v)) := by
4057:     rw [← hinit]
4058:     rw [emit_run (satPadTM (M i) K (hk i)).tm (satHostTM M K hk).tm emb (satHostRet M i)
4059:       (by intros; rfl) pre _ v (by
4060:         intro u hu
4061:         rw [satPad_run]
4062:         exact hg u (by omega))]
4063:     rw [satPad_run]
4064:   constructor
4065:   · intro v hv
4066:     rw [hrun v (Nat.le_of_lt hv)]
4067:     have hl := hg v hv
4068:     cases hs : ((M i).tm.runFrom c v).state with
4069:     | none => exact False.elim (hl hs)
4070:     | some s => simp [emitCfg, satPadCfg, hs, emb]
4071:   · rw [hrun t (Nat.le_refl _), show (M i).tm.runFrom c t = _ from he]
4072:     exact satHost_seam M K i hp x result pre out q none
```

## TCSlib/Complexity/ClassNP/SAT.lean:4190–4203

```lean
4190: /-- Specialize a clean module to one call site in the finite host. -/
4191: private lemma satHost_clean (M : Fin 6 → FinTM Bool) (K : ℕ) (hk : ∀ i, (M i).k ≤ K)
4192:     (i : Fin 6) (f g : List Bool → List Bool) (B : ℕ → ℕ)
4193:     (h : SatClean (M i) f g B) (x arg pre : List Bool) :
4194:     ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ B arg.length ∧
4195:       (∀ v < t, ((satHostTM M K hk).tm.runFrom
4196:         {Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (satHostEntry M i) (stateWord K arg) with output := pre} v).state
4197:           ≠ some (.inl ())) ∧
4198:       (satHostTM M K hk).tm.runFrom
4199:         {Cfg.ofWords (input := x) (satHostEntry M i) (stateWord K arg) with output := pre} t =
4200:         {Cfg.ofWords (satHostRet M i) (stateWord K (f arg)) with output := pre ++ g arg} := by
4201:   obtain ⟨t, hp, ht, hg, he⟩ := h.2 x arg
4202:   obtain ⟨hguard, hend⟩ := satHost_call M K hk i h.1 x arg (f arg) (g arg) pre (M i).tm.q₀ t hg he
4203:   exact ⟨t, hp, ht, hguard, hend⟩
```

## TCSlib/Complexity/ClassNP/SAT.lean:4074–4087

```lean
4074: /-- Joining two guarded segments preserves the first-return guard when the
4075: intermediate seam is also outside the anchor. -/
4076: private lemma sat_guard_add {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
4077:     (tm : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (anchor : S) (c d : Cfg k Bool S x) (a b : ℕ)
4078:     (ha : ∀ v < a, (tm.runFrom c v).state ≠ some anchor)
4079:     (he : tm.runFrom c a = d)
4080:     (hb : ∀ v < b, (tm.runFrom d v).state ≠ some anchor) :
4081:     ∀ v < a + b, (tm.runFrom c v).state ≠ some anchor := by
4082:   intro v hv
4083:   by_cases h : v < a
4084:   · exact ha v h
4085:   · have hva : a ≤ v := by omega
4086:     rw [← Nat.add_sub_of_le hva, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, he]
4087:     exact hb (v - a) (by omega)
```

## TCSlib/Complexity/ClassNP/SAT.lean:4089–4095

```lean
4089: /-- Uniform clean-module contract: a first halt with a prescribed replacement
4090: word and emitted chunk, over every untouched native input. -/
4091: private def SatClean (M : FinTM Bool) (result emit : List Bool → List Bool) (B : ℕ → ℕ) : Prop :=
4092:   0 < M.k ∧ ∀ x arg : List Bool, ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t ≤ B arg.length ∧
4093:     (∀ v < t, ¬(M.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) M.tm.q₀ (stateWord M.k arg)) v).Halted) ∧
4094:     M.tm.runFrom (Cfg.ofWords (input := x) M.tm.q₀ (stateWord M.k arg)) t =
4095:       {Cfg.ofWords M.tm.q₀ (stateWord M.k (result arg)) with state := none, output := emit arg}
```

## TCSlib/Complexity/ClassNP/SAT.lean:3906–3914

```lean
3906: /-- Convert a first-positive-exit module into a halting source for `emit_run`.
3907: The Boolean release flag ensures even an entry equal to exit executes once. -/
3908: private def satStopTM (C : FinTM Bool) (entry exit : C.State) : FinTM Bool where
3909:   k := C.k
3910:   State := Bool × C.State
3911:   tm := { q₀ := (false, entry)
3912:           tr := fun q inp work =>
3913:             if q.1 = true ∧ q.2 = exit then FinTM.controlAction 0 none
3914:             else {C.tm.tr q.2 inp work with state := (C.tm.tr q.2 inp work).state.map (true, ·)} }
```

## TCSlib/Complexity/ClassNP/SAT.lean:3855–3860

```lean
3855: /-- Configuration embedding for the shared bank; the padding is genuinely blank. -/
3856: private def satPadCfg {k K : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
3857:     (c : Cfg k Bool S x) : Cfg K Bool S x :=
3858:   ⟨c.state, c.inputPos,
3859:     fun i => if h : i.val < k then c.workTapes ⟨i.val, h⟩ else fun _ => none,
3860:     fun i => if h : i.val < k then c.workTapePos ⟨i.val, h⟩ else 0, c.output⟩
```

## TCSlib/Complexity/ClassNP/SAT.lean:2774–2785

```lean
2774: /-- Finite one-way transducer for local word operations used by round-field
2775: assembly. It uses no work tapes and always halts at the right boundary. -/
2776: private def satMapTM {S : Type} [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S]
2777:     (next : S → Bool → S) (emit : S → Bool → Option Bool)
2778:     (finish : S → Option Bool) (start : S) : FinTM Bool where
2779:   k := 0
2780:   State := S
2781:   tm := {
2782:     q₀ := start
2783:     tr := fun q inp _ => match inp with
2784:       | some b => ⟨.pos, Fin.elim0, emit q b, some (next q b)⟩
2785:       | none => ⟨0, Fin.elim0, finish q, none⟩ }
```

## TCSlib/Complexity/ClassNP/SAT.lean:3842–3845

```lean
3842: /-- Pad a callable module into a shared bank, keeping unused tapes stationary. -/
3843: private def satPadAction {k K : ℕ} {S : Type} (a : Action k Bool S) : Action K Bool S :=
3844:   ⟨a.inputTape, fun i => if h : i.val < k then a.workTapes ⟨i.val, h⟩ else (none, 0),
3845:     a.output, a.state⟩
```

## TCSlib/Complexity/ClassNP/SAT.lean:3916–3919

```lean
3916: /-- Release-flag embedding preserves all physical fields of a call. -/
3917: private def satStopCfg {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
3918:     (b : Bool) (c : Cfg k Bool S x) : Cfg k Bool (Bool × S) x :=
3919:   ⟨c.state.map (b, ·), c.inputPos, c.workTapes, c.workTapePos, c.output⟩
```

## TCSlib/Complexity/ClassNP/SAT.lean:4117–4136

```lean
4117: /-- The bridge overhead is bounded by one monomial of degree one higher.
4118: **Proof sketch.** Output length is bounded by source time; `n+1` and both
4119: source-time terms fit the larger power. The last unit pays for stopping. -/
4120: private lemma sat_bridge_bound (c A d n len : ℕ) (hlen : len ≤ A * (n + 1) ^ d) :
4121:     c * (A * (n + 1) ^ d + n + len + 1) + 1 ≤
4122:       (c * (2 * A + 1) + 1) * (n + 1) ^ (d + 1) := by
4123:   have hd := Nat.mul_le_mul_left A
4124:     (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.succ_pos n) (show d ≤ d + 1 by omega))
4125:   simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one] at hd
4126:   have hn : n + 1 ≤ (n + 1) ^ (d + 1) := by
4127:     simpa using Nat.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.succ_pos n) (show 1 ≤ d + 1 by omega)
4128:   have h1 : 1 ≤ (n + 1) ^ (d + 1) := by omega
4129:   calc
4130:     _ ≤ c * ((2 * A + 1) * (n + 1) ^ (d + 1)) + 1 := by
4131:       apply Nat.add_le_add_right
4132:       apply Nat.mul_le_mul_left
4133:       simp only [Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul, Nat.mul_assoc, two_mul]
4134:       omega
4135:     _ ≤ c * ((2 * A + 1) * (n + 1) ^ (d + 1)) + (n + 1) ^ (d + 1) := Nat.add_le_add_left h1 _
4136:     _ = _ := by ring
```

## TCSlib/Complexity/CookLevin/Hardness.lean:6719–6730

```lean
6719: /-- Finite one-way transducer for local word operations used by round-field
6720: assembly. It uses no work tapes and always halts at the right boundary. -/
6721: private def clA5MapTM {S : Type} [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S]
6722:     (next : S → Bool → S) (emit : S → Bool → Option Bool)
6723:     (finish : S → Option Bool) (start : S) : FinTM Bool where
6724:   k := 0
6725:   State := S
6726:   tm := {
6727:     q₀ := start
6728:     tr := fun q inp _ => match inp with
6729:       | some b => ⟨.pos, Fin.elim0, emit q b, some (next q b)⟩
6730:       | none => ⟨0, Fin.elim0, finish q, none⟩ }
```

## TCSlib/Complexity/CookLevin/Hardness.lean:6181–6184

```lean
6181: /-- Pad a callable module into a shared bank, keeping unused tapes stationary. -/
6182: private def clA5PadAction {k K : ℕ} {S : Type} (a : Action k Bool S) : Action K Bool S :=
6183:   ⟨a.inputTape, fun i => if h : i.val < k then a.workTapes ⟨i.val, h⟩ else (none, 0),
6184:     a.output, a.state⟩
```

## TCSlib/Complexity/CookLevin/Hardness.lean:6255–6258

```lean
6255: /-- Release-flag embedding preserves all physical fields of a call. -/
6256: private def clA5StopCfg {k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
6257:     (b : Bool) (c : Cfg k Bool S x) : Cfg k Bool (Bool × S) x :=
6258:   ⟨c.state.map (b, ·), c.inputPos, c.workTapes, c.workTapePos, c.output⟩
```

## TCSlib/Complexity/CookLevin/Hardness.lean:6455–6474

```lean
6455: /-- The bridge overhead is bounded by one monomial of degree one higher.
6456: **Proof sketch.** Output length is bounded by source time; `n+1` and both
6457: source-time terms fit the larger power. The last unit pays for stopping. -/
6458: private lemma clA5_bridge_bound (c A d n len : ℕ) (hlen : len ≤ A * (n + 1) ^ d) :
6459:     c * (A * (n + 1) ^ d + n + len + 1) + 1 ≤
6460:       (c * (2 * A + 1) + 1) * (n + 1) ^ (d + 1) := by
6461:   have hd := Nat.mul_le_mul_left A
6462:     (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.succ_pos n) (show d ≤ d + 1 by omega))
6463:   simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one] at hd
6464:   have hn : n + 1 ≤ (n + 1) ^ (d + 1) := by
6465:     simpa using Nat.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.succ_pos n) (show 1 ≤ d + 1 by omega)
6466:   have h1 : 1 ≤ (n + 1) ^ (d + 1) := by omega
6467:   calc
6468:     _ ≤ c * ((2 * A + 1) * (n + 1) ^ (d + 1)) + 1 := by
6469:       apply Nat.add_le_add_right
6470:       apply Nat.mul_le_mul_left
6471:       simp only [Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul, Nat.mul_assoc, two_mul]
6472:       omega
6473:     _ ≤ c * ((2 * A + 1) * (n + 1) ^ (d + 1)) + (n + 1) ^ (d + 1) := Nat.add_le_add_left h1 _
6474:     _ = _ := by ring
```

## TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Contract/Basic.lean:459–478

```lean
459: /-- **Same-machine concatenation** (the `recordRun_trans` pattern): segments sharing the forbidden
460: set and the relation concatenate, with lengths adding and **no dispatch step**.
461: 
462: **Proof sketch.** Split a time at the first length `t`. Before it, use the first segment; after
463: it, the run is the second segment's from `b` (`Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add`). -/
464: theorem trans {a b c : Cfg k Γ S x} {t v : ℕ} (h : Segment M F P a b t)
465:     (g : Segment M F P b c v) : Segment M F P a c (t + v) := by
466:   refine ⟨by rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, h.1, g.1], ?_, ?_⟩
467:   · intro u hu
468:     by_cases hut : u < t
469:     · exact h.2.1 u hut
470:     · have he : u = t + (u - t) := by omega
471:       rw [he, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, h.1]
472:       exact g.2.1 _ (by omega)
473:   · intro u hu
474:     by_cases hut : u ≤ t
475:     · exact h.2.2 u hut
476:     · have he : u = t + (u - t) := by omega
477:       rw [he, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, h.1]
478:       exact g.2.2 _ (by omega)
```

## TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Contract/Basic.lean:443–447

```lean
443: /-- The empty segment: zero steps, with the start's head vector satisfying the relation. -/
444: theorem zero {a : Cfg k Γ S x} (h : P a.workTapePos) : Segment M F P a a 0 :=
445:   ⟨rfl, fun _ hu => absurd hu (Nat.not_lt_zero _), fun u hu => by
446:     obtain rfl : u = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp hu
447:     exact h⟩
```

## TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Contract/Basic.lean:497–500

```lean
497: /-- Weakening: a smaller forbidden set and a weaker relation. -/
498: theorem mono {F' : Set (Option S)} {P' : (Fin k → ℤ) → Prop} {a b : Cfg k Γ S x} {t : ℕ}
499:     (h : Segment M F P a b t) (hF : F' ⊆ F) (hP : ∀ p, P p → P' p) : Segment M F' P' a b t :=
500:   ⟨h.1, fun u hu hm => h.2.1 u hu (hF hm), fun u hu => hP _ (h.2.2 u hu)⟩
```

## TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Contract/Basic.lean:429–436

```lean
429: /-- `Turing.Segment M F P a b t` holds exactly when `M.runFrom a t = b`, no state at a time
430: `u < t` lies in `F`, and the head vector satisfies `P` at every time `u ≤ t` (the definition as
431: a lemma). -/
432: theorem segment_iff {S : Type} {x : List Γ} (M : MultiTapeTM k Γ S) (F : Set (Option S))
433:     (P : (Fin k → ℤ) → Prop) (a b : Cfg k Γ S x) (t : ℕ) :
434:     Segment M F P a b t ↔ M.runFrom a t = b ∧ (∀ u < t, (M.runFrom a u).state ∉ F) ∧
435:       ∀ u ≤ t, P (M.runFrom a u).workTapePos :=
436:   Iff.rfl
```

## TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/Contract/Basic.lean:421–427

```lean
421: /-- **A segment**: the run of `M` from `a` reaches `b` after exactly `t` steps, no state at a
422: time before `t` lies in the forbidden set `F`, and the head vector satisfies `P` at every time up
423: to `t`. Nothing is said about the endpoint's state. -/
424: def Segment {S : Type} {x : List Γ} (M : MultiTapeTM k Γ S) (F : Set (Option S))
425:     (P : (Fin k → ℤ) → Prop) (a b : Cfg k Γ S x) (t : ℕ) : Prop :=
426:   M.runFrom a t = b ∧ (∀ u < t, (M.runFrom a u).state ∉ F) ∧
427:     ∀ u ≤ t, P (M.runFrom a u).workTapePos
```

## TCSlib/Complexity/ClassNP/Tautology.lean:1281–1286

```lean
1281: /-- A segment records its exact endpoint and excludes the anchor strictly
1282: before that endpoint. It is used only after the initial release transition. -/
1283: private def tautDualSegment {x : List Bool}
1284:     (c d : Cfg 0 Bool TautDualControl x) (t : ℕ) : Prop :=
1285:   tautDualTM.tm.runFrom c t = d ∧
1286:     ∀ j < t, (tautDualTM.tm.runFrom c j).state ≠ some .anchor
```

## TCSlib/Complexity/ClassNP/Tautology.lean:1288–1296

```lean
1288: /-- `tautDualSegment` is the segment layer at the transducer's parameters: the segment
1289: (`Turing.Segment`) of `tautDualTM.tm` with the anchor forbidden and no head relation.
1290: Consecutive segments compose, without hiding an earlier anchor visit, by
1291: `Turing.Segment.trans` through this bridge. -/
1292: private lemma tautDualSegment_iff_segment {x : List Bool}
1293:     (c d : Cfg 0 Bool TautDualControl x) (t : ℕ) :
1294:     tautDualSegment c d t ↔ Segment tautDualTM.tm {some .anchor} (fun _ => True) c d t := by
1295:   rw [Turing.segment_iff]
1296:   exact ⟨fun h => ⟨h.1, h.2, fun _ _ => trivial⟩, fun h => ⟨h.1, h.2.1⟩⟩
```

## TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/CounterLoop.lean:818–828

```lean
818: /-- Common trajectory data for a finite host segment, with a chosen set of
819: permitted body-head vectors. -/
820: private def counterSpan {k : ℕ} {Γ S : Type} {x : List Γ}
821:     (H : MultiTapeTM (k + 1) Γ (CounterLoopState S))
822:     (z : Cfg (k + 1) Γ (CounterLoopState S) x) (t : ℕ) (cp : ℤ) (width : ℕ)
823:     (R : (Fin k → ℤ) → Prop) : Prop :=
824:   (∀ u < t, (H.runFrom z u).state ≠ some .done ∧
825:     (H.runFrom z u).state ≠ some .escape) ∧
826:   (∀ u ≤ t, (H.runFrom z u).workTapePos (Fin.last k) ∈
827:     Finset.Icc (cp - 1) (cp + (width : ℤ))) ∧
828:   (∀ u ≤ t, R (fun j => (H.runFrom z u).workTapePos j.castSucc))
```

## TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Build/CounterLoop.lean:830–848

```lean
830: /-- `counterSpan` is the segment layer at the counter loop's parameters: the segment
831: (`Turing.Segment`) from `z` to its run endpoint over both exits, whose head relation puts the
832: counter head in its interval and the body heads in `R`. Concatenation and weakening are
833: `Turing.Segment.trans` and `Turing.Segment.mono` through this bridge. -/
834: private lemma counterSpan_iff_segment {k : ℕ} {Γ S : Type} {x : List Γ}
835:     (H : MultiTapeTM (k + 1) Γ (CounterLoopState S))
836:     (z : Cfg (k + 1) Γ (CounterLoopState S) x) (t : ℕ) (cp : ℤ) (width : ℕ)
837:     (R : (Fin k → ℤ) → Prop) :
838:     counterSpan H z t cp width R ↔
839:       Segment H {some .done, some .escape}
840:         (fun p => p (Fin.last k) ∈ Finset.Icc (cp - 1) (cp + (width : ℤ)) ∧
841:           R fun j => p j.castSucc)
842:         z (H.runFrom z t) t := by
843:   rw [Turing.segment_iff]
844:   exact ⟨fun ⟨hc, hh, hr⟩ => ⟨rfl, fun u hu hm => Or.elim hm (hc u hu).1 (hc u hu).2,
845:       fun u hu => ⟨hh u hu, hr u hu⟩⟩,
846:     fun ⟨_, hc, hp⟩ =>
847:       ⟨fun u hu => ⟨fun h => hc u hu (Or.inl h), fun h => hc u hu (Or.inr h)⟩,
848:         fun u hu => (hp u hu).1, fun u hu => (hp u hu).2⟩⟩
```

## TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Robustness/SingleTape.lean:1181–1186

```lean
1181: /-- A finite run together with containment at all its prefixes. The endpoints
1182: are physical coordinates, and both are counted. -/
1183: private def DGSpan {A Q : Type} {x : List A} (tm : MultiTapeTM 1 A Q)
1184:     (c d : Cfg 1 A Q x) (t : ℕ) (lo hi : ℤ) : Prop :=
1185:   tm.runFrom c t = d ∧ ∀ u ≤ t,
1186:     lo ≤ (tm.runFrom c u).workTapePos 0 ∧ (tm.runFrom c u).workTapePos 0 ≤ hi
```

## TCSlib/Complexity/TuringMachine/Robustness/SingleTape.lean:1188–1196

```lean
1188: /-- `DGSpan` is the segment layer with nothing forbidden: the segment (`Turing.Segment`) of
1189: `tm` whose head relation keeps the one work head in `[lo, hi]`. Concatenating contained runs,
1190: which preserves containment at every physical time, is `Turing.Segment.trans` through this
1191: bridge. -/
1192: private lemma dgSpan_iff_segment {A Q : Type} {x : List A} (tm : MultiTapeTM 1 A Q)
1193:     (c d : Cfg 1 A Q x) (t : ℕ) (lo hi : ℤ) :
1194:     DGSpan tm c d t lo hi ↔ Segment tm ∅ (fun p => lo ≤ p 0 ∧ p 0 ≤ hi) c d t := by
1195:   rw [Turing.segment_iff]
1196:   exact ⟨fun h => ⟨h.1, fun _ _ hm => hm, h.2⟩, fun h => ⟨h.1, h.2.2⟩⟩
```
